title.zh: 卷八 本紀第八 明帝
title.raw: 卷八 本紀第八 明帝 Volume 8 Annals 8: Emperor Ming

sentences.zh: 太宗明皇帝諱彧，字休炳，小字榮期，文帝第十一子也。

translations.literal: Emperor Ming, posthumous title Taizong, taboo name Yu, courtesy name Xiubing, childhood name Rongqi, was the eleventh son of Emperor Wen.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ming, posthumous title Taizong, taboo name Yu, courtesy name Xiubing, childhood name Rongqi, was the eleventh son of Emperor Wen.

sentences.zh: 元嘉十六年十月戊寅生。

translations.literal: He was born on wu-yin day in the tenth month of the sixteenth year of Yuanjia.
translations.idiomatic: He was born on wu-yin day in the tenth month of the sixteenth year of Yuanjia.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，封淮陽王，食邑二千戶。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year he was enfeoffed as Prince of Huaiyang with a fief of two thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year he was enfeoffed as Prince of Huaiyang with a fief of two thousand households.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，改封湘東王。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year his enfeoffment was changed to Prince of Xiangdong.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year his title was changed to Prince of Xiangdong.

sentences.zh: 元凶弒立，以為驍騎將軍，加給事中。

translations.literal: When the murderer-prince seized the throne by regicide, he was made General of Galloping Cavalry and given the additional post of Supervisor of Attendants.
translations.idiomatic: When the murderer-prince murdered his way to the throne, he was appointed General of Galloping Cavalry and given the additional post of Supervisor of Attendants.

sentences.zh: 世祖踐阼，為祕書監，遷冠軍將軍、南蘭陵下邳二郡太守，領石頭戍事。

translations.literal: When Shizu ascended the throne, he was made Supervisor of the Palace Library, then promoted to General Who Conquers and Administrator of Nanlanling and Xiapi commanderies, concurrently holding the garrison command at Shitou.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaowu took the throne, he was made Supervisor of the Palace Library, then promoted to General Who Conquers and Administrator of Nanlanling and Xiapi, with concurrent command of the Shitou garrison.

sentences.zh: 孝建元年，徙為南彭城、東海二郡太守，將軍如故，鎮京口。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xiaojian he was transferred as Administrator of Nan Pengcheng and Donghai commanderies; his rank as general was unchanged, and he was stationed at Jingkou.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xiaojian he was reassigned as Administrator of Nan Pengcheng and Donghai while keeping his general's rank, and he was posted at Jingkou.

sentences.zh: 其年，徵為中護軍。

translations.literal: That same year he was summoned to serve as Colonel of the Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: That same year he was recalled to serve as Colonel of the Garrison.

sentences.zh: 二年，遷侍中，領游擊將軍。

translations.literal: In the second year he was promoted to Attendant-in-Ordinary, concurrently holding the post of General Who Attacks in Mobile Warfare.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was promoted to Attendant-in-Ordinary and made General Who Attacks in Mobile Warfare.

sentences.zh: 三年，徙衞尉，侍中如故。

translations.literal: In the third year he was transferred to Minister of the Guard; Attendant-in-Ordinary remained unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was transferred to Minister of the Guard while retaining his post as Attendant-in-Ordinary.

sentences.zh: 又為左衞將軍，衞尉如故。

translations.literal: He was also made General of the Left Guard; Minister of the Guard remained unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: He was also appointed General of the Left Guard while continuing as Minister of the Guard.

sentences.zh: 大明元年，轉中護軍，衞尉如故。

translations.literal: In the first year of Daming he was transferred to Colonel of the Garrison; Minister of the Guard remained unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Daming he was made Colonel of the Garrison while remaining Minister of the Guard.

sentences.zh: 三年，為都官尚書，領游擊將軍，衞尉如故。

translations.literal: In the third year he was made Minister of Justice, concurrently General Who Attacks in Mobile Warfare; Minister of the Guard remained unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was appointed Minister of Justice and General Who Attacks in Mobile Warfare while still serving as Minister of the Guard.

sentences.zh: 七年，遷領軍將軍。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was promoted to General of the Palace Guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was promoted to General of the Palace Guard.

sentences.zh: 八年，出為使持節、都督徐兗二州豫州之梁郡諸軍事、鎮北將軍、徐州刺史，給鼓吹一部。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was sent out with Bearer of the Staff with Full Powers, as Commander-in-Chief of military affairs for Xu and Yan provinces and Liang commandery in Yuzhou, General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Xuzhou, and granted one set of drums and pipes.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was sent out bearing the staff with full powers as Commander-in-Chief of military affairs for Xu and Yan provinces and Liang commandery in Yuzhou, appointed General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Xuzhou, and granted one set of drums and pipes.

sentences.zh: 其年，徵為侍中、護軍將軍。

translations.literal: That year he was summoned as Attendant-in-Ordinary and General Who Protects the Army.
translations.idiomatic: That year he was recalled as Attendant-in-Ordinary and General Who Protects the Army.

sentences.zh: 未拜，復為領軍將軍，侍中如故。

translations.literal: Before accepting the appointment, he was again made General of the Palace Guard; Attendant-in-Ordinary remained unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: Before he could take up the new post, he was again made General of the Palace Guard while remaining Attendant-in-Ordinary.

sentences.zh: 廢帝景和末，上入朝，被留停都。

translations.literal: At the end of Jinghe in the Deposed Emperor's reign, the Prince entered the capital for audience and was detained in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Jinghe era under the Deposed Emperor, the Prince came to court for an audience and was kept in the capital.

sentences.zh: 廢帝誅害宰輔，殺戮大臣，恒慮有圖之者，疑畏諸父，並拘之殿內，遇上無禮，事在文諸王傳。

translations.literal: The Deposed Emperor executed chief ministers and slaughtered great officials, constantly fearing plotters; suspicious and afraid of his uncles, he confined them all within the palace halls. Toward the Prince he was rude; the details are in the princes' biographies.
translations.idiomatic: The Deposed Emperor killed chief ministers and slaughtered senior officials, always fearing conspirators. Suspicious of his uncles, he confined them within the palace halls and treated the Prince with gross disrespect; the full account appears in the biographies of the princes.

sentences.zh: 遂收上付廷尉，一宿被原。

translations.literal: Then the Prince was handed over to the Court of Justice; within one night he was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince was then handed over to the Court of Justice, but within a single night he was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 將加禍害者，前後非一。

translations.literal: Instances when harm was about to be inflicted upon him were not few, before and after.
translations.idiomatic: More than once, before and after, he narrowly escaped plans to destroy him.

sentences.zh: 既而害上意定，明旦便應就禍。

translations.literal: When it was finally decided to harm the Prince, the next morning he should have met disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Once the Deposed Emperor had settled on killing the Prince, he was to have been destroyed the very next morning.

sentences.zh: 上先已與腹心阮佃夫、李道兒等密共合謀。

translations.literal: The Prince had already secretly plotted together with his trusted men Ruan Tianfu, Li Dao'er, and others.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince had already entered into a secret plot with his trusted followers Ruan Tianfu, Li Dao'er, and others.

sentences.zh: 于時廢帝左右常慮禍及，人人有異志。

translations.literal: At that time those around the Deposed Emperor constantly feared calamity would reach them; everyone had divergent intentions.
translations.idiomatic: By then those close to the Deposed Emperor lived in constant fear for their lives, and each man nursed his own separate design.

sentences.zh: 唯有直閤將軍宗越、譚金、童太一等數人為其腹心，並虓虎有幹力，在殿省久，眾並畏服之，故莫敢動。

translations.literal: Only Direct Attendant-General Zong Yue, Tan Jin, Tong Taiyi, and several others were his trusted men—all fierce tigers with capacity, long in palace service, all feared and submitted to—so none dared act.
translations.idiomatic: Only Direct Attendant-General Zong Yue, Tan Jin, Tong Taiyi, and a few others remained his trusted inner circle—men as fierce as tigers, strong in action, and long established in palace service, whom everyone feared and obeyed—so no one dared move against them.

sentences.zh: 是夕，越等並外宿。

translations.literal: That evening Yue and the others all lodged outside.
translations.idiomatic: That night Yue and the others were all billeted outside the palace.

sentences.zh: 佃夫、道兒因結壽寂之等殞廢帝於後堂。

translations.literal: Tianfu and Dao'er then joined with Shou Jizhi and others to kill the Deposed Emperor in the rear hall.
translations.idiomatic: Tianfu and Dao'er then joined Shou Jizhi and others in killing the Deposed Emperor in the rear hall.

sentences.zh: 十一月二十九日夜也。

translations.literal: It was the night of the twenty-ninth day of the eleventh month.
translations.idiomatic: This took place on the night of the twenty-ninth day of the eleventh month.

sentences.zh: 事定，上未知所為。

translations.literal: When the affair was settled, the Prince did not yet know what to do.
translations.idiomatic: Once the deed was done, the Prince still did not know what he should do next.

sentences.zh: 建安王休仁便稱臣奉引升西堂，登御坐，召見諸大臣。

translations.literal: Prince Xiuren of Jian'an immediately declared himself subject and led him up to the Western Hall, mounted the imperial seat, and summoned the various great ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Xiuren of Jian'an at once declared himself his subject, led him up to the Western Hall, seated him on the imperial throne, and summoned the senior ministers.

sentences.zh: 于時事起倉卒，上失履，跣至西堂，猶著烏帽。

translations.literal: At that time the affair arose in sudden haste; the Prince lost his shoes and went barefoot to the Western Hall, still wearing a black cap.
translations.idiomatic: The coup had erupted in sudden confusion: the Prince lost his shoes and ran barefoot to the Western Hall, still wearing a black cap.

sentences.zh: 坐定，休仁呼主衣以白帽代之，令備羽儀。

translations.literal: When seated, Xiuren called the Master of Imperial Wardrobes to replace it with a white cap and ordered the imperial guard of honor prepared.
translations.idiomatic: Once he was seated, Xiuren summoned the Master of Imperial Wardrobes to bring a white cap in its place and ordered the imperial guard of honor made ready.

sentences.zh: 雖未即位，凡眾事悉稱令書施行。

translations.literal: Although he had not yet ascended the throne, all matters were executed in the name of directoral orders.
translations.idiomatic: Although he had not yet formally ascended the throne, every affair was carried out under directoral orders in his name.

sentences.zh: 己未，司徒揚州刺史豫章王子尚、山陰公主並賜死。

translations.literal: On ji-wei day Minister and Inspector of Yangzhou Prince Zishang of Yuzhang and the Princess of Shanyin were both granted death.
translations.idiomatic: On ji-wei day Minister and Inspector of Yangzhou Prince Zishang of Yuzhang and the Princess of Shanyin were both ordered to take their own lives.

sentences.zh: 宗越、譚金、童太一謀反伏誅。

translations.literal: Zong Yue, Tan Jin, and Tong Taiyi plotted rebellion and were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Zong Yue, Tan Jin, and Tong Taiyi plotted rebellion and were put to death.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚申朔，令書以司空東海王褘為中書監、太尉，鎮軍將軍、江州刺史晉安王子勛進號車騎將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On geng-shen, first day of the twelfth month, a directoral order made Grand Minister of Works Prince Kui of Donghai Supervisor of the Secretariat and Grand Marshal; General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Jiangzhou Prince Zixun of Jin'an was promoted to General of Chariots and Cavalry with Staff equal to Three Divisions.
translations.idiomatic: On geng-shen day, the first of the twelfth month, a directoral order appointed Grand Minister of Works Prince Kui of Donghai Supervisor of the Secretariat and Grand Marshal, and promoted General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Jiangzhou Prince Zixun of Jin'an to General of Chariots and Cavalry with protocol equal to a three-division office.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以新除驃騎大將軍建安王休仁為司徒、尚書令、揚州刺史，鎮軍將軍、開府儀同三司山陽王休祐進號驃騎大將軍、荊州刺史。

translations.literal: On gui-hai, newly appointed General-in-Chief Who Runs Fast Prince Xiuren of Jian'an was made Minister, Director of the Masters of Writing, and Inspector of Yangzhou; General Who Pacifies the Army with Staff equal to Three Divisions Prince Xiuyou of Shanyang was promoted to General-in-Chief Who Runs Fast and Inspector of Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gui-hai day newly appointed General-in-Chief Who Runs Fast Prince Xiuren of Jian'an was made Minister, Director of the Masters of Writing, and Inspector of Yangzhou, while General Who Pacifies the Army with protocol equal to a three-division office Prince Xiuyou of Shanyang was promoted to General-in-Chief Who Runs Fast and Inspector of Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 崇憲衞尉桂陽王休範為鎮北將軍、南徐州刺史。

translations.literal: Minister of the Guard for Chongxian Prince Xiufan of Guiyang was made General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Southern Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of the Guard for Chongxian Prince Xiufan of Guiyang was appointed General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Southern Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，改封安陸王子綏為江夏王。

translations.literal: On yi-chou the enfeoffment of Prince Zisui of Anlu was changed to Prince of Jiangxia.
translations.idiomatic: On yi-chou day Prince Zisui of Anlu was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Jiangxia.

sentences.zh: 泰始元年冬十二月丙寅，上即皇帝位。

translations.literal: On bing-yin in the twelfth month of winter, first year of Taishi, the Prince ascended the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: On bing-yin day in the twelfth month of the first year of Taishi, the Prince ascended the imperial throne.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：

translations.literal: An edict said:
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared:

sentences.zh: 高祖武皇帝德洞四瀛，化綿九服。

translations.literal: The High Ancestor Martial Emperor's virtue filled the four seas; his transforming influence extended to the nine domains.
translations.idiomatic: The High Ancestor Martial Emperor's virtue reached through the four seas, and his transforming influence spread across the nine domains.

sentences.zh: 太祖文皇帝以大明定基；

translations.literal: The Great Ancestor Civil Emperor secured the foundation with Daming;
translations.idiomatic: The Great Ancestor Civil Emperor established the dynasty's foundation in the Daming era;

sentences.zh: 世祖孝武皇帝以下武寧亂。

translations.literal: Emperor Xiaowu with martial power quelled disorder.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaowu with martial power quelled the realm's disorder.

sentences.zh: 日月所照，梯山航海；

translations.literal: Where sun and moon shine, they climbed mountains and sailed seas;
translations.idiomatic: Wherever sun and moon shone, men climbed mountains and crossed seas to submit;

sentences.zh: 風雨所均，削衽襲帶。

translations.literal: Where wind and rain reach, they cut their lapels and adjusted their sashes.
translations.idiomatic: wherever wind and rain fell, they cut their lapels and bound up their sashes in obedience.

sentences.zh: 所以業固盛漢，聲溢隆周。

translations.literal: Thus their enterprise surpassed flourishing Han; their renown overflowed august Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Thus their achievement outshone the height of Han, and their fame surpassed the glory of Zhou.

sentences.zh: 子業凶嚚自天，忍悖成性，人面獸心，見於齠日，反道敗德，著自比年。

translations.literal: Ziye was vicious and stupid by nature from Heaven; cruelty and rebellion formed his character. A human face with a beast's heart appeared from childhood; perverse of the Way and ruined in virtue, this was evident these recent years.
translations.idiomatic: Ziye was savage and stupid from birth, cruelty and rebellion bred into his nature. Even as a child he showed a human face hiding a beast's heart; in recent years his perversity and moral ruin have become plain to all.

sentences.zh: 其狎侮五常，怠棄三正，矯誣上天，毒流下國，實開闢所未有，書契所未聞。

translations.literal: He trampled the five constants, abandoned the three orthodoxies, deceived Heaven on high, and poison flowed through the realm—truly never since the opening of the world, never heard of in written records.
translations.idiomatic: He trampled the five constants, cast aside the three orthodoxies, deceived Heaven itself, and let poison seep through the realm—deeds unheard of since the world began and unrecorded in any chronicle.

sentences.zh: 再罹遏密，而無一日之哀；

translations.literal: Twice he suffered the curtained seclusion, yet without a day's grief;
translations.idiomatic: Twice he entered the curtained mourning seclusion, yet never mourned for a single day;

sentences.zh: 齊斬在躬，方深北里之樂。

translations.literal: While hempen mourning garments were on his person, he deeply indulged in pleasures of the northern quarters.
translations.idiomatic: even while the hempen garments of deepest mourning were upon him, he abandoned himself to the pleasures of the pleasure quarters.

sentences.zh: 虎兕難匣，憑河必彰，遂誅滅上宰，窮釁逆之酷，虐害國輔，究孥戮之刑。

translations.literal: Tigers and rhinos could not be caged; relying on the river he must reveal himself—thus he executed and exterminated chief ministers, exhausting the cruelty of rebellion; abused and harmed state ministers, carrying out punishment to the extermination of families.
translations.idiomatic: Like a tiger or rhinoceros that no cage could hold, his cruelty could not be concealed—so he slaughtered chief ministers in the full extremity of treason, abused the pillars of state, and carried punishments to the annihilation of whole clans.

sentences.zh: 子鸞同生，以昔憾殄殪。

translations.literal: Ziluan was born of the same womb; because of a past grudge he was destroyed and killed.
translations.idiomatic: Ziluan was his own brother by the same mother, yet an old grievance moved him to destroy and kill him.

sentences.zh: 敬猷兄弟，以睚眦殲夷。

translations.literal: The brothers Jingyou were annihilated over a grudge in the eye.
translations.idiomatic: The brothers Jingyou were wiped out over the smallest slight.

sentences.zh: 徵逼義陽，將加屠膾。

translations.literal: He summoned and pressured Yiyang, intending to add slaughter and mincing.
translations.idiomatic: He summoned and pressed the Prince of Yiyang, intending to butcher and mince him.

sentences.zh: 陵辱戚藩，檟楚妃主。

translations.literal: He insulted and humiliated imperial princes by marriage, flogging princesses and consorts.
translations.idiomatic: He humiliated imperial princes related by marriage and flogged princesses and imperial consorts.

sentences.zh: 奪立左右，竊子置儲，肆酗于朝，宣淫于國。

translations.literal: He seized appointment of those around him, installed a bastard as heir, indulged in drunkenness at court, and spread lewdness through the realm.
translations.idiomatic: He placed his favorites in office, installed a bastard as heir apparent, drank to excess at court, and spread debauchery throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 事穢東陵，行汙飛走。

translations.literal: His conduct defiled Dongling; his deeds polluted flying and running creatures.
translations.idiomatic: His conduct shamed even the licentious tales of Dongling; his deeds befouled bird and beast alike.

sentences.zh: 積釁罔極，日月滋深。

translations.literal: Accumulated guilt without limit; day by day it deepened.
translations.idiomatic: His accumulated crimes knew no limit and deepened with every passing day.

sentences.zh: 比遂圖犯玄宮，志窺題湊，將肆梟、鏡之禍，騁商、頓之心。

translations.literal: Recently he then plotted to violate the spirit palace, his ambition spied at the imperial tally; he would unleash the punishments of dismemberment and boiling, and give free rein to the hearts of Shang and Dun.
translations.idiomatic: Recently he plotted to violate the imperial tombs and cast his eyes upon the throne itself; he would have unleashed punishments of dismemberment and boiling and indulged the cruelty of kings Shang and Li.

sentences.zh: 又欲鴆毒崇憲，虐加諸父，事均宮閫，聲遍國都。

translations.literal: He also wished to poison with zhen Prince Chongxian, extending cruelty to his uncles; the affair matched palace gates, and the rumor filled the capital.
translations.idiomatic: He also planned to poison Prince Chongxian and extend his cruelty to his uncles; the plot touched the inner palace gates, and word of it filled the capital.

sentences.zh: 鴟梟小豎，莫不寵暱，朝廷忠誠，必也戮挫。

translations.literal: Owls, owlets, and petty lads—all were favored and intimate; loyal officials of the court were invariably slaughtered and thwarted.
translations.idiomatic: Owls, fledglings, and petty lads were all favored intimates, while loyal court officials were slaughtered without exception.

sentences.zh: 收掩之旨，虓虎結轍；

translations.literal: Orders for arrest and seizure—ferocious tigers linked wheel tracks;
translations.idiomatic: Orders for arrest and seizure went out in unbroken streams, like wheel tracks left by ravening tigers;

sentences.zh: 掠奪之使，白刃相望。

translations.literal: Envoys of plunder—naked blades faced one another.
translations.idiomatic: and plundering envoys went forth until naked blades confronted one another on every road.

sentences.zh: 百僚危氣，首領無有全地；

translations.literal: All officials lived in peril; none had ground to keep head intact;
translations.idiomatic: Every official lived in terror, with no safe ground on which to keep his head;

sentences.zh: 萬姓崩心，妻子不復相保。

translations.literal: The myriad people were heartsick; wives and children could no longer protect one another.
translations.idiomatic: and the common people were heartsick, unable even to protect their wives and children.

sentences.zh: 所以鬼哭山鳴，星鉤血降，神器殆於馭索，景祚危於綴旒。

translations.literal: Therefore ghosts wailed and mountains shrieked, stars hooked and blood fell; the sacred vessel nearly fell from the chariot reins, and the luminous fortune perilously hung from the tassels.
translations.idiomatic: Ghosts wailed and mountains screamed, stars bent and blood rained down; the sacred vessel nearly slipped from the charioteer's grasp, and the dynasty's fortune hung by a thread from the imperial tassels.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以安西將軍、南豫州刺史劉遵考為特進、右光祿大夫，輔國將軍、歷陽南譙二郡太守建平王景素為南豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On ji-si day General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Southern Yuzhou Liu Zunkao was made Special Grand Master and Right Grand Master of the Palace; General Who Assists the State and Administrator of Liyang and Nan Qiao commanderies Prince Jingsu of Jianping was made Inspector of Southern Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On ji-si day General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Southern Yuzhou Liu Zunkao was appointed Special Grand Master and Right Grand Master of the Palace, and General Who Assists the State and Administrator of Liyang and Nan Qiao commanderies Prince Jingsu of Jianping was made Inspector of Southern Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以荊州刺史臨海王子頊為鎮軍將軍，南徐州刺史永嘉王子仁為中軍將軍，[1]左衞將軍劉道隆為中護軍。

translations.literal: On geng-wu day Inspector of Jingzhou Prince Zixu of Linhai was made General Who Pacifies the Army; Inspector of Southern Xuzhou Prince Ziren of Yongjia was made General of the Center Army, [1] General of the Left Guard Liu Daolong was made Colonel of the Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: On geng-wu day Inspector of Jingzhou Prince Zixu of Linhai was appointed General Who Pacifies the Army; Inspector of Southern Xuzhou Prince Ziren of Yongjia was made General of the Center Army; [1] and General of the Left Guard Liu Daolong was appointed Colonel of the Garrison.

sentences.zh: 辛未，改封臨賀王子產為南平王，晉熙王子輿為廬陵王。

translations.literal: On xin-wei day the enfeoffment of Prince Zichan of Linhe was changed to Prince of Nanping; Prince Ziyu of Jinxi was changed to Prince of Luling.
translations.idiomatic: On xin-wei day Prince Zichan of Linhe was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Nanping, and Prince Ziyu of Jinxi as Prince of Luling.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以尚書左僕射王景文為尚書僕射。

translations.literal: On ren-shen day Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Jingwen was made Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On ren-shen day Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Jingwen was promoted to Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 新除中護軍劉道隆卒。

translations.literal: Newly appointed Colonel of the Garrison Liu Daolong died.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Daolong, newly appointed Colonel of the Garrison, died.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，[2]詔曰：「朕戡亂寧民，屬膺景祚。

translations.literal: On gui-you day, [2] an edict said: "I have quelled disorder and settled the people, and have received the luminous fortune.
translations.idiomatic: On gui-you day, [2] an edict declared: "I have quelled disorder and brought peace to the people, and have received Heaven's luminous mandate.

sentences.zh: 鴻制初造，革道惟新。

translations.literal: The great design is first made; the Way is reformed with renewal alone.
translations.idiomatic: A new order is being forged, and the Way itself is being remade.

sentences.zh: 而國故頻罹，仁澤偏壅。

translations.literal: Yet the state suffered frequent calamities; benevolent grace was unevenly blocked.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the state has suffered repeated calamities, and benevolent grace has not reached everywhere equally.

sentences.zh: 每鑒寐疚心，罔識攸濟。

translations.literal: Each reflection keeps me sleepless with guilt; I know not how to cross over.
translations.idiomatic: Each time I reflect on this I lie awake in guilt, not knowing how to set things right.

sentences.zh: 巡方問俗，弘政所先，可分遣大使，廣求民瘼，考守宰之良，採衡閭之善。

translations.literal: Touring the regions and inquiring into customs is the first priority in extending governance; imperial envoys may be dispatched separately on a wide scale to seek the people's afflictions, examine the goodness of governors and prefects, and collect the excellence of village lanes.
translations.idiomatic: Touring the realm and learning its customs must come first in good government. Let imperial envoys be sent out broadly to seek out the people's hardships, assess the merit of governors and magistrates, and gather reports of virtue from village lanes.

sentences.zh: 若獄犴淹枉，傷民害教者，具以事聞。

translations.literal: If prison cases long detain the wrongly accused, injuring people and harming teaching—they should report the matter in full.
translations.idiomatic: Where prison cases long detain the innocent and harm both the people and public morals, let the facts be reported in full.

sentences.zh: 鰥寡孤獨，癃殘六疾，不能自存者，郡縣優量賑給。

translations.literal: Widowers, widows, orphans, solitaries, the disabled and six kinds of affliction—those unable to support themselves—let commanderies and counties generously measure out relief.
translations.idiomatic: Widowers, widows, orphans, the solitary, the disabled, and those suffering the six afflictions who cannot support themselves should receive generous measured relief from their commanderies and counties.

sentences.zh: 貞婦孝子，高行力田，詳悉條奏。

translations.literal: Chaste wives, filial sons, high conduct and hardworking farming—report in detail item by item.
translations.idiomatic: Chaste wives, filial sons, persons of outstanding conduct, and diligent farmers should be reported in full, item by item.

sentences.zh: [3]務詢輿誦，廣納嘉謀，每盡皇華之旨，俾若朕親覽焉。

translations.literal: [3] Strive to inquire into songs from the lanes, widely receive excellent counsel; fully exhaust the intent of the imperial envoys, as though I personally examined them.
translations.idiomatic: [3] Hear the songs of the common people, welcome good counsel from every quarter, and let the envoys carry out their mission fully, as though I myself were reviewing each report.

sentences.zh: 」乙亥，追尊所生沈婕妤曰宣皇太后。

translations.literal: " On yi-hai day, the birth mother Lady Shen was posthumously honored as Empress Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: " On yi-hai day the Emperor's birth mother, Lady Shen, was posthumously honored as Empress Xuan.

sentences.zh: 後軍將軍垣閎為司州刺史，前右將軍長史殷琰為豫州刺史。

translations.literal: General of the Rear Guard Yuan Hong was made Inspector of Si; former Chief Clerk of the General of the Right Yin Yan was made Inspector of Yu.
translations.idiomatic: General of the Rear Guard Yuan Hong was appointed Inspector of Si, and former Chief Clerk of the General of the Right Yin Yan was appointed Inspector of Yu.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔曰：「皇室多故，糜費滋廣，且久歲不登，公私歉弊。

translations.literal: On bing-zi day, an edict said: "The imperial house has many troubles; waste and expense grow ever broader; moreover harvests have failed for years; public and private are impoverished.
translations.idiomatic: On bing-zi day an edict declared: "The imperial house has endured many troubles; waste and expense grow ever greater; harvests have failed for years, and both public and private coffers are exhausted.

sentences.zh: 方刻意從儉，弘濟時艱，政道未孚，慨愧兼積。

translations.literal: Now we deliberately practice austerity to broadly relieve the times' hardship; government Way is not yet trusted—in sighs and shame this accumulates.
translations.idiomatic: We must now deliberately practice austerity to relieve the hardship of the age, yet government has not yet won the people's trust—a burden of sighs and shame weighs upon us.

sentences.zh: 太官供膳，可詳所減撤，尚方御府雕文篆刻無益之物，一皆蠲省，務存簡約，以稱朕心。

translations.literal: The Chief Steward's provision of meals should be examined for detail on reductions; the Imperial Workshop and Palace Storehouse's carved inscriptions and seal engravings and useless items—all exempted and reduced; strive to preserve simplicity, to match my heart.
translations.idiomatic: Let the Chief Steward's provision of meals be reviewed in detail for cuts; let carved ornament, seal engraving, and every useless item in the Imperial Workshop and Palace Storehouse be abolished or reduced. Preserve simplicity in all things, as my heart desires.

sentences.zh: 」戊寅，崇太后為崇憲皇太后。

translations.literal: " On wu-yin day, Empress Dowager Chong was elevated to Grand Empress Dowager Chongxian.
translations.idiomatic: " On wu-yin day Empress Dowager Chong was elevated to Grand Empress Dowager Chongxian.

sentences.zh: 立皇后王氏。

translations.literal: Empress Wang was installed.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Wang was installed.

sentences.zh: 鎮軍將軍、江州刺史晉安王子勛舉兵反，鎮軍長史鄧琬為其謀主，雍州刺史袁顗率眾赴之。

translations.literal: Prince Zixun of Jin'an, General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Jiangzhou, raised troops in rebellion; Chief Clerk of the Pacifying Army Deng Wan was his chief plotter; Inspector of Yong Yuan Yi led troops to join him.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Zixun of Jin'an, General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Jiangzhou, rose in rebellion; Chief Clerk of the Pacifying Army Deng Wan was his chief strategist, and Inspector of Yong Yuan Yi marched to join him.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，驃騎大將軍、前荊州刺史山陽王休祐改為江州刺史，荊州刺史臨海王子頊即留本任。

translations.literal: On xin-si day Prince Xiuyou of Shanyang, General-in-Chief Who Runs Fast and former Inspector of Jingzhou, was changed to Inspector of Jiangzhou; Inspector of Jingzhou Prince Zixu of Linhai remained in his original post.
translations.idiomatic: On xin-si day Prince Xiuyou of Shanyang, General-in-Chief Who Runs Fast and former Inspector of Jingzhou, was reassigned as Inspector of Jiangzhou, while Inspector of Jingzhou Prince Zixu of Linhai remained in his original post.

sentences.zh: 加領軍將軍王玄謨鎮軍將軍。

translations.literal: General of the Palace Guard Wang Xuamo was given the additional title General Who Pacifies the Army.
translations.idiomatic: General of the Palace Guard Wang Xuamo was given the additional title General Who Pacifies the Army.

sentences.zh: 壬午，車駕謁太廟。

translations.literal: On ren-wu day the imperial carriage visited the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On ren-wu day the Emperor visited the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 甲申，後將軍、郢州刺史安陸王子綏進號征南將軍，右將軍、會稽太守尋陽王子房進號安東將軍，前將軍、荊州刺史臨海王子頊進號平西將軍。

translations.literal: On jia-shen day Rear General and Inspector of Ying Prince Zisui of Anlu was promoted to General Who Punishes the South; General of the Right and Administrator of Kuaiji Prince Zifang of Xunyang was promoted to General Who Pacifies the East; General of the Van and Inspector of Jing Prince Zixu of Linhai was promoted to General Who Pacifies the West.
translations.idiomatic: On jia-shen day Rear General and Inspector of Ying Prince Zisui of Anlu was promoted to General Who Punishes the South; General of the Right and Administrator of Kuaiji Prince Zifang of Xunyang was promoted to General Who Pacifies the East; and General of the Van and Inspector of Jing Prince Zixu of Linhai was promoted to General Who Pacifies the West.

sentences.zh: 子綏、子房、子頊並不受命，舉兵同逆。

translations.literal: Zisui, Zifang, and Zixu all refused the orders and raised troops in joint rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Zisui, Zifang, and Zixu all refused their appointments and rose in joint rebellion.

sentences.zh: 戊子，新除中軍將軍永嘉王子仁為護軍將軍。

translations.literal: On wu-zi day newly appointed General of the Center Army Prince Ziren of Yongjia was made General Who Protects the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On wu-zi day newly appointed General of the Center Army Prince Ziren of Yongjia was made General Who Protects the Army.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月己丑朔，以軍事不朝會。

translations.literal: Second year, spring, first month, ji-chou first day of new moon—because of military affairs the court audience was not held.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, on ji-chou day, the first of the first month of spring, the regular court audience was not held because of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以金紫光祿大夫王僧朗為左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On geng-yin day Grand Master of the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon Wang Senglang was made Left Grand Master of the Palace with Staff equal to Three Divisions.
translations.idiomatic: On geng-yin day Grand Master of the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon Wang Senglang was appointed Left Grand Master of the Palace with protocol equal to a three-division office.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，驃騎大將軍、江州刺史山陽王休祐改為南豫州刺史，鎮歷陽。

translations.literal: On ren-chen day Prince Xiuyou of Shanyang, General-in-Chief Who Runs Fast and Inspector of Jiangzhou, was changed to Inspector of Southern Yuzhou, stationed at Liyang.
translations.idiomatic: On ren-chen day Prince Xiuyou of Shanyang, General-in-Chief Who Runs Fast and Inspector of Jiangzhou, was reassigned as Inspector of Southern Yuzhou and posted at Liyang.

sentences.zh: 鎮軍將軍、領軍將軍王玄謨為車騎將軍、江州刺史，平北將軍、徐州刺史薛安都進號安北將軍。

translations.literal: General Who Pacifies the Army and General of the Palace Guard Wang Xuamo was made General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Jiangzhou; General Who Levels the North and Inspector of Xuzhou Xue Andu was promoted to General Who Pacifies the North.
translations.idiomatic: General Who Pacifies the Army and General of the Palace Guard Wang Xuamo was appointed General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Jiangzhou, and General Who Levels the North and Inspector of Xuzhou Xue Andu was promoted to General Who Pacifies the North.

sentences.zh: 安都亦不受命。

translations.literal: Andu also refused the order.
translations.idiomatic: Andu also refused the appointment.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以左衞將軍巴陵王休若為鎮東將軍，新除安東將軍尋陽王子房為撫軍將軍，司徒左長史袁愍孫為領軍將軍。

translations.literal: On guisi, General of the Left Guard Prince Xiuofan of Baling was made General Who Guards the East; newly appointed General Who Pacifies the East Prince Zifang of Xunyang was made General Who Comforts the Army; the Chancellor's Left Chief Clerk Yuan Minsun was made General of the Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day General of the Left Guard Prince Xiuofan of Baling was appointed General Who Guards the East; newly appointed General Who Pacifies the East Prince Zifang of Xunyang was made General Who Comforts the Army; and the Chancellor's Left Chief Clerk Yuan Minsun was appointed General of the Garrison.

sentences.zh: 甲午，中外戒嚴。

translations.literal: On jiawu, armament was proclaimed throughout the court and the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day martial law was proclaimed inside and outside the capital.

sentences.zh: 司徒建安王休仁都督征討諸軍事，統眾軍南討。

translations.literal: Prince Xiuren of Jian'an as Chancellor was made Commander-in-Chief of Pacification and Punitive Forces, leading all armies south to attack.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Xiuren of Jian'an, serving as Chancellor, was appointed Commander-in-Chief of Pacification and Punitive Forces and led all armies south to attack.

sentences.zh: 以青州刺史劉祗為南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: Inspector of Qing Liu Zhi was made Inspector of Southern Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Inspector of Qing Liu Zhi was appointed Inspector of Southern Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以征虜司馬申令孫為徐州刺史，義陽內史龐孟虯為司州刺史。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Chief Clerk of the General Who Conquers the Barbarians Shen Lingsun was made Inspector of Xu; Interior Administrator of Yiyang Pang Mengjiao was made Inspector of Si.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day Chief Clerk of the General Who Conquers the Barbarians Shen Lingsun was appointed Inspector of Xu, and Interior Administrator of Yiyang Pang Mengjiao was appointed Inspector of Si.

sentences.zh: 令孫、孟虯及豫州刺史殷琰、青州刺史沈文秀、冀州刺史崔道固、湘州行事何慧文、廣州刺史袁曇遠、益州刺史蕭惠開、梁州刺史柳元怙並同叛逆。

translations.literal: Lingsun, Mengjiao, and Inspector of Yu Yin Yan, Inspector of Qing Shen Wenxiu, Inspector of Ji Cui Daogu, Acting Inspector of Xiang He Huiwen, Inspector of Guang Yuan Tanyuan, Inspector of Yi Xiao Huikai, and Inspector of Liang Liu Yuanhu all likewise rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Lingsun, Mengjiao, and Inspectors Yin Yan of Yu, Shen Wenxiu of Qing, Cui Daogu of Ji, Acting Inspector He Huiwen of Xiang, Yuan Tanyuan of Guang, Xiao Huikai of Yi, and Liu Yuanhu of Liang all joined the rebellion.

sentences.zh: 兗州刺史殷孝祖入衞京都，仍遣孝祖前鋒南伐。

translations.literal: Inspector of Yan Yin Xiaozu entered to guard the capital; he was then sent as vanguard south to attack.
translations.idiomatic: Inspector of Yan Yin Xiaozu entered the capital to defend it and was then dispatched as vanguard on the southern campaign.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，加孝祖撫軍將軍。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Xiaozu was given the additional rank General Who Comforts the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day Xiaozu was also made General Who Comforts the Army.

sentences.zh: 丙午，車駕親御六師，出頓中興堂。

translations.literal: On bingwu, the imperial carriage in person commanded the Six Armies and went out to halt at the Hall of Central Revival.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day the Emperor personally took command of the Six Armies and advanced to encamp at the Hall of Central Revival.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，驃騎大將軍、南豫州刺史山陽王休祐改為豫州刺史，統眾軍西討。

translations.literal: On xinhai, General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Southern Yuzhou Prince Xiuyou of Shanyang was changed to Inspector of Yu, commanding all armies west to attack.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Southern Yuzhou Prince Xiuyou of Shanyang was reassigned as Inspector of Yu and placed in command of all armies on the western campaign.

sentences.zh: 吳郡太守顧琛、吳興太守王曇生、義興太守劉延熙、晉陵太守袁摽、山陽太守程天祚並舉兵反。

translations.literal: Administrator of Wu Gu Chen, Administrator of Wuxing Wang Tansheng, Administrator of Yixing Liu Yanxi, Administrator of Jinling Yuan Biao, and Administrator of Shanyang Cheng Tianzuo all raised troops in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Administrator of Wu Gu Chen, Administrator of Wuxing Wang Tansheng, Administrator of Yixing Liu Yanxi, Administrator of Jinling Yuan Biao, and Administrator of Shanyang Cheng Tianzuo all rose in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 鎮東將軍巴陵王休若統眾軍東討。

translations.literal: General Who Guards the East Prince Xiuofan of Baling commanded all armies east to attack.
translations.idiomatic: General Who Guards the East Prince Xiuofan of Baling took command of all armies on the eastern campaign.

sentences.zh: 壬子，崇憲皇太后崩。

translations.literal: On renzi, Grand Empress Dowager Chongxian died.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day Grand Empress Dowager Chongxian died.

sentences.zh: 是日，軍主任農夫、劉懷珍平定義興。

translations.literal: That same day army commanders Ren Nongfu and Liu Huaizhen pacified Yixing.
translations.idiomatic: That same day the army commanders Ren Nongfu and Liu Huaizhen brought Yixing back under control.

sentences.zh: 永世縣民史逸宗據縣為逆，殿中將軍陸攸之討平之。

translations.literal: The commoner Shi Yizong of Yongshi county seized the county in rebellion; Palace General Lu Youzhi attacked and pacified him.
translations.idiomatic: A commoner of Yongshi county named Shi Yizong seized the county in rebellion; Palace General Lu Youzhi attacked and put down the rising.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以新除左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司王僧朗為特進，左光祿大夫如故。

translations.literal: On bingchen, newly appointed Left Grand Master of the Palace with Staff equal to Three Divisions Wang Senglang was made Special Grand Master; Left Grand Master of the Palace remained unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day newly appointed Left Grand Master of the Palace with protocol equal to a three-division office Wang Senglang was made Special Grand Master while retaining his post as Left Grand Master of the Palace.

sentences.zh: 二月乙丑，僧朗卒。

translations.literal: Second month, yichou day, Senglang died.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the yichou day, Senglang died.

sentences.zh: 尚書僕射王景文父憂去職。

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Jingwen left office on his father's mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Jingwen left office to observe mourning for his father.

sentences.zh: 曲赦吳、吳興、義興、晉陵四郡。

translations.literal: A partial amnesty was granted to the four commanderies Wu, Wuxing, Yixing, and Jinling.
translations.idiomatic: A partial amnesty was granted to the four commanderies of Wu, Wuxing, Yixing, and Jinling.

sentences.zh: 吏部尚書蔡興宗為尚書左僕射，吳興太守張永、右軍將軍齊王東討，平晉陵。

translations.literal: Minister of Personnel Cai Xingzong was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; Administrator of Wuxing Zhang Yong and General of the Right Guard Prince of Qi marched east to attack and pacified Jinling.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Personnel Cai Xingzong was appointed Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; Administrator of Wuxing Zhang Yong and General of the Right Guard Prince of Qi marched east to attack and pacified Jinling.

sentences.zh: 癸未，曲赦浙江東五郡。

translations.literal: On guiwei, a partial amnesty was granted to the five commanderies east of the Zhe River.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day a partial amnesty was granted to the five commanderies east of the Zhe River.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，鎮東將軍巴陵王休若進號衞將軍。

translations.literal: On dinghai, General Who Guards the East Prince Xiuofan of Baling was advanced in rank to General of the Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day General Who Guards the East Prince Xiuofan of Baling was promoted to General of the Guard.

sentences.zh: 建武將軍吳喜公率諸軍破賊於吳、吳興、會稽，平定三郡，同逆皆伏誅。

translations.literal: General Who Establishes Might Wu Xi at the head of the armies broke the rebels in Wu, Wuxing, and Kuaiji, pacified the three commanderies, and all fellow rebels were executed.
translations.idiomatic: General Who Establishes Might Wu Xi led the armies to defeat the rebels in Wu, Wuxing, and Kuaiji, pacified the three commanderies, and all who had joined the rebellion were put to death.

sentences.zh: 輔國將軍齊王前鋒北討，輔國將軍劉勔前鋒西討。

translations.literal: General Who Assists the State Prince of Qi as vanguard marched north to attack; General Who Assists the State Liu Yan as vanguard marched west to attack.
translations.idiomatic: General Who Assists the State Prince of Qi advanced as vanguard on the northern campaign; General Who Assists the State Liu Yan advanced as vanguard on the western campaign.

sentences.zh: [4]賊劉胡領眾四萬據赭圻。

translations.literal: [4] The rebel Liu Hu led a host of forty thousand and held Zheqi.
translations.idiomatic: [4] The rebel Liu Hu led forty thousand men and occupied Zheqi.

sentences.zh: 三月庚寅，撫軍將軍殷孝祖攻赭圻，死之。

translations.literal: Third month, gengyin day, General Who Comforts the Army Yin Xiaozu attacked Zheqi and died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the gengyin day, General Who Comforts the Army Yin Xiaozu attacked Zheqi and was killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 以輔國將軍沈攸之代為南討前鋒。

translations.literal: General Who Assists the State Shen Youzhi was made vanguard of the southern campaign in his place.
translations.idiomatic: General Who Assists the State Shen Youzhi was appointed vanguard of the southern campaign in his place.

sentences.zh: [5]賊眾稍盛，袁顗頓鵲尾，聯營迄至濃湖，眾十餘萬。

translations.literal: [5] The rebel host gradually grew stronger; Yuan Yan encamped at Quewei, and linked camps stretched all the way to Nonghu—more than a hundred thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: [5] The rebel forces steadily grew stronger; Yuan Yan encamped at Quewei, and his linked camps stretched from there to Nonghu, numbering more than a hundred thousand men.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以新除太子詹事張永為青、冀二州刺史。

translations.literal: On renchen, newly appointed Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent Zhang Yong was made Inspector of Qing and Ji.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day newly appointed Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent Zhang Yong was appointed Inspector of Qing and Ji.

sentences.zh: 丙申，鎮北將軍、南徐州刺史桂陽王休範總統北討諸軍事。

translations.literal: On bingshen, General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Southern Xuzhou Prince Xiufan of Guiyang was made overall commander of the northern punitive forces.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Southern Xuzhou Prince Xiufan of Guiyang was appointed overall commander of the northern punitive campaign.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以尚書劉思考為徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Director of the Masters of Writing Liu Sikao was made Inspector of Xu.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day Director of the Masters of Writing Liu Sikao was appointed Inspector of Xu.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，貶尋陽王子房爵為松滋縣侯。

translations.literal: On wuxu, the enfeoffment of Prince Zifang of Xunyang was degraded to Marquis of Songzi county.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day Prince Zifang of Xunyang was degraded in rank to Marquis of Songzi county.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以奉朝請鄭黑為司州刺史。

translations.literal: On yisi, Court Gentleman-for-the-Duration Zheng Hei was made Inspector of Si.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day Court Gentleman-for-the-Duration Zheng Hei was appointed Inspector of Si.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，鎮北將軍、南徐州刺史桂陽王休範領南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On xinhai, General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Southern Xuzhou Prince Xiufan of Guiyang also held Inspector of Southern Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Southern Xuzhou Prince Xiufan of Guiyang was also made Inspector of Southern Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬子，斷新錢，專用古錢。

translations.literal: On renzi, new coin was abolished; only old coin was to be used.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day new coin was abolished and only old coin was permitted in circulation.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，原赦揚、南徐二州囚繫，凡逋亡一無所問。

translations.literal: On guichou, prisoners in Yang and Southern Xu were pardoned; all who had fled were questioned about nothing.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day prisoners in Yang and Southern Xu were pardoned, and all fugitives were granted full amnesty without inquiry.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬午，以散騎侍郎明僧暠為青州刺史。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, renwu day, Gentleman Cadet of Scattered Cavalry Ming Senghao was made Inspector of Qing.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on the renwu day Gentleman Cadet of Scattered Cavalry Ming Senghao was appointed Inspector of Qing.

sentences.zh: 五月壬辰，以輔國將軍沈攸之為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: Fifth month, renchen day, General Who Assists the State Shen Youzhi was made Inspector of Yong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the renchen day General Who Assists the State Shen Youzhi was appointed Inspector of Yong.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，曲赦豫州。

translations.literal: On dingyou, a partial amnesty was granted to Yu.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day a partial amnesty was granted to Yu province.

sentences.zh: 丁未，新除尚書僕射王景文為中軍將軍，以青、冀二州刺史張永為鎮軍將軍。

translations.literal: On dingwei, newly appointed Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Jingwen was made General of the Center Army; Inspector of Qing and Ji Zhang Yong was made General Who Guards the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day newly appointed Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Jingwen was made General of the Center Army, and Inspector of Qing and Ji Zhang Yong was appointed General Who Guards the Army.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以寧朔將軍劉乘民為冀州刺史。

translations.literal: On gengxu, General Who Pacifies the North Liu Chengmin was made Inspector of Ji.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day General Who Pacifies the North Liu Chengmin was appointed Inspector of Ji.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，葬崇憲皇太后於修寧陵。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Grand Empress Dowager Chongxian was buried at Xiuning Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day Grand Empress Dowager Chongxian was buried at Xiuning Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: [6]冠軍將軍、益州刺史蕭惠開進號平西將軍。

translations.literal: [6] General Who Conquers the Champions and Inspector of Yi Xiao Huikai was advanced in rank to General Who Pacifies the West.
translations.idiomatic: [6] General Who Conquers the Champions and Inspector of Yi Xiao Huikai was promoted to General Who Pacifies the West.

sentences.zh: 六月辛酉，鎮軍將軍張永領徐州刺史。

translations.literal: Sixth month, xinyou day, General Who Guards the Army Zhang Yong also held Inspector of Xu.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the xinyou day General Who Guards the Army Zhang Yong was also made Inspector of Xu.

sentences.zh: 京師雨水，丁卯，遣殿中將軍檢行賜卹。

translations.literal: Rain fell in the capital; on dingmao Palace Generals were dispatched to inspect and grant relief.
translations.idiomatic: Rain fell heavily in the capital; on the dingmao day palace generals were sent out to inspect the damage and grant relief.

sentences.zh: 以左軍將軍垣恭祖為梁、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: General of the Left Army Yuan Gongzu was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin.
translations.idiomatic: General of the Left Army Yuan Gongzu was appointed Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己丑，鎮北將軍、南徐兗二州刺史桂陽王休範進號征北大將軍。

translations.literal: Seventh month, jichou day, General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Southern Xu and Yan Prince Xiufan of Guiyang was advanced in rank to General Who Campaigns North.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on the jichou day General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Southern Xu and Yan Prince Xiufan of Guiyang was promoted to General Who Campaigns North.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，鎮軍將軍、徐州刺史張永改為南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On xinmao, General Who Guards the Army and Inspector of Xu Zhang Yong was changed to Inspector of Southern Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day General Who Guards the Army and Inspector of Xu Zhang Yong was reassigned as Inspector of Southern Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以仇池太守楊僧嗣為北秦州刺史、武都王。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Defender of Chouchi Yang Sengsi was made Inspector of Northern Qin and Prince of Wudu.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day Defender of Chouchi Yang Sengsi was appointed Inspector of Northern Qin and enfeoffed as Prince of Wudu.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以男子時朗之為北豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On renyin, the commoner Shi Langzhi was made Inspector of Northern Yu.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day the commoner Shi Langzhi was appointed Inspector of Northern Yu.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，龍驤將軍劉道符平山陽。

translations.literal: On yisi, General of the Flying Dragons Liu Daofu pacified Shanyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day General of the Flying Dragons Liu Daofu pacified Shanyang.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，又以義軍主鄭叔舉為北豫州刺史，鎮軍將軍、南兗州刺史張永復領徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Volunteer Army Commander Zheng Shuju was again made Inspector of Northern Yu; General Who Guards the Army and Inspector of Southern Yanzhou Zhang Yong again held Inspector of Xu.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day Volunteer Army Commander Zheng Shuju was again appointed Inspector of Northern Yu, and General Who Guards the Army and Inspector of Southern Yanzhou Zhang Yong was again made Inspector of Xu.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，復以冀州刺史崔道固為徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Inspector of Ji Cui Daogu was again made Inspector of Xu.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day Inspector of Ji Cui Daogu was again appointed Inspector of Xu.

sentences.zh: 八月己卯，司徒建安王休仁率眾軍大破賊，斬偽尚書僕射袁顗，進討江、郢、荊、雍、湘五州，平定之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, jimao day, Chancellor Prince Xiuren of Jian'an led the armies to a great defeat of the rebels, beheaded the false Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Yuan Yan, and advanced to attack the five provinces Jiang, Ying, Jing, Yong, and Xiang, pacifying them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the jimao day Chancellor Prince Xiuren of Jian'an led the armies to a crushing defeat of the rebels, beheaded the rebel Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Yuan Yan, and advanced against the five provinces of Jiang, Ying, Jing, Yong, and Xiang, bringing them all to submission.

sentences.zh: 晉安王子勛、安陸王子綏、臨海王子頊、邵陵王子元並賜死，同黨皆伏誅。

translations.literal: Prince Zixun of Jin'an, Prince Zisui of Anlu, Prince Zixu of Linhai, and Prince Ziyuan of Shaoling were all granted death; all fellow partisans were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Zixun of Jin'an, Prince Zisui of Anlu, Prince Zixu of Linhai, and Prince Ziyuan of Shaoling were all ordered to take their own lives, and all their partisans were put to death.

sentences.zh: 諸將軍帥封賞各有差。

translations.literal: The various generals and commanders received enfeoffments and rewards each according to merit.
translations.idiomatic: The various generals and commanders received enfeoffments and rewards in proportion to their merit.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以護軍將軍、永嘉王子仁為平南將軍、湘州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiashen, General Who Protects the Army and Prince Ziren of Yongjia was made General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day General Who Protects the Army Prince Ziren of Yongjia was appointed General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of Xiang.

sentences.zh: 九月乙酉，曲赦江、郢、荊、雍、湘五州；

translations.literal: Ninth month, yiyou day, a partial amnesty was granted to the five provinces Jiang, Ying, Jing, Yong, and Xiang;
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the yiyou day a partial amnesty was granted to the five provinces of Jiang, Ying, Jing, Yong, and Xiang;

sentences.zh: 守宰不得離職。

translations.literal: governors and magistrates might not leave their posts.
translations.idiomatic: and local governors and magistrates were forbidden to leave their posts.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，驃騎大將軍、豫州刺史山陽王休祐改為荊州刺史。

translations.literal: On renchen, General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Yu Prince Xiuyou of Shanyang was changed to Inspector of Jing.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Yu Prince Xiuyou of Shanyang was reassigned as Inspector of Jing.

sentences.zh: 分豫州立南豫州。

translations.literal: From Yu province Southern Yu was established.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Yu province was carved out from Yu.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，六軍解嚴。

translations.literal: On guisi, the Six Armies stood down from martial law.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day the Six Armies stood down from martial law.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下，賜民爵一級。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm; the people were granted one rank of nobility.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm, and the common people were granted one rank of nobility.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以中軍將軍王景文為安南將軍、江州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiawu, General of the Center Army Wang Jingwen was made General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of Jiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day General of the Center Army Wang Jingwen was appointed General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of Jiang.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以車騎將軍、江州刺史王玄謨為左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司、護軍將軍。

translations.literal: On wuxu, General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Jiang Wang Xuanmo was made Left Grand Master of the Palace with Staff equal to Three Divisions and General Who Protects the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Jiang Wang Xuanmo was appointed Left Grand Master of the Palace with protocol equal to a three-division office and General Who Protects the Army.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以建安王休仁世子伯融為豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On gengzi, the heir of Prince Xiuren of Jian'an, Borong, was made Inspector of Yu.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day Borong, heir of Prince Xiuren of Jian'an, was appointed Inspector of Yu.

sentences.zh: [7]辛丑，衞將軍巴陵王休若即本號為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: [7] On xinchou, General of the Guard Prince Xiuofan of Baling, retaining his original rank, was made Inspector of Yong.
translations.idiomatic: [7] On the xinchou day General of the Guard Prince Xiuofan of Baling, while retaining his original rank, was appointed Inspector of Yong.

sentences.zh: 雍州刺史沈攸之為郢州刺史。

translations.literal: Inspector of Yong Shen Youzhi was made Inspector of Ying.
translations.idiomatic: Inspector of Yong Shen Youzhi was appointed Inspector of Ying.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以太子左衞率建平王景素為南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Leader of the Left Guard of the Heir Apparent Prince Jingsu of Jianping was made Inspector of Southern Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day Leader of the Left Guard of the Heir Apparent Prince Jingsu of Jianping was appointed Inspector of Southern Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 十月乙卯，永嘉王子仁、始安王子真、淮南王子孟、南平王子產、廬陵王子輿、松滋侯子房並賜死。

translations.literal: Tenth month, yimao day, Prince Ziren of Yongjia, Prince Zizhen of Shian, Prince Zimeng of Huainan, Prince Zichan of Nanping, Prince Ziyu of Luling, and Marquis Zifang of Songzi were all granted death.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on the yimao day Prince Ziren of Yongjia, Prince Zizhen of Shian, Prince Zimeng of Huainan, Prince Zichan of Nanping, Prince Ziyu of Luling, and Marquis Zifang of Songzi were all ordered to take their own lives.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以郢州刺史沈攸之為中領軍，與張永俱北討。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Inspector of Ying Shen Youzhi was made General of the Garrison and marched north to attack together with Zhang Yong.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day Inspector of Ying Shen Youzhi was made General of the Garrison and marched north to campaign together with Zhang Yong.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以吳郡太守顧覬之為湘州刺史。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Administrator of Wu Gu Jizhi was made Inspector of Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day Administrator of Wu Gu Jizhi was appointed Inspector of Xiang.

sentences.zh: [8]戊寅，立皇子昱為皇太子。

translations.literal: [8] On wuyin, the imperial son Yu was established as Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: [8] On the wuyin day the imperial son Yu was established as Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 曲赦揚、南徐二州。

translations.literal: A partial amnesty was granted to Yang and Southern Xu.
translations.idiomatic: A partial amnesty was extended to Yang and Southern Xu provinces.

sentences.zh: [9]以輔國將軍劉勔為廣州刺史，左軍將軍張世為豫州刺史。

translations.literal: [9] General Who Assists the State Liu Yan was made Inspector of Guang; General of the Left Army Zhang Shi was made Inspector of Yu.
translations.idiomatic: [9] General Who Assists the State Liu Yan was appointed Inspector of Guang, and General of the Left Army Zhang Shi was appointed Inspector of Yu.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲申，以安成太守劉襲為郢州刺史。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, jiashen day, Administrator of Ancheng Liu Xi was made Inspector of Ying.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the jiashen day Administrator of Ancheng Liu Xi was appointed Inspector of Ying.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔曰：「治崇簡易，化疾繁侈，遠關隆替，明著軌跡者也。

translations.literal: An edict said: "In governing, esteem what is simple and easy; in transforming the people, hasten to cut off what is elaborate and extravagant—far and near, rise and fall, this is clearly shown in the tracks left behind.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "Good government rests on simplicity; reform of the people requires cutting off extravagance—through rise and fall, near and far, the lesson is written plain in history.

sentences.zh: 朕拯斯墜運，屬此屯極，仍之以凋耗，因之以師旅，而識昧前王，務艱昔代。

translations.literal: I have rescued this fallen fortune and inherited this extremity of hardship; upon it came further depletion, and upon that came armies on campaign—yet my understanding is dim before the former kings, and my tasks are hard compared with past ages.
translations.idiomatic: I have rescued a dynasty in collapse and inherited an age of extremity; upon that came further ruin, and upon that came endless campaigning—yet my understanding falls short of the former kings, and my burdens exceed those of past ages.

sentences.zh: 俾夫舊賦既繁，為費彌廣，鑒寐萬務，每思弘革。

translations.literal: Thus the old levies were already heavy, and expense grew ever broader; reflecting on the myriad affairs whether waking or sleeping, I constantly think of broad reform.
translations.idiomatic: The old levies were already crushing, and expense grew ever greater; waking or sleeping, I reflect on the myriad affairs of state and constantly seek broad reform.

sentences.zh: 方欲緩繇優調，愛民為先，有司詳加寬惠，更立科品。

translations.literal: I now intend to ease corvée and lighten assessments, putting love of the people first; let the offices examine and add lenience in detail, and establish new categories of levy.
translations.idiomatic: I now intend to ease corvée labor and lighten tax assessments, putting the welfare of the people first; let the offices review the levies in detail, grant further lenience, and establish new categories of assessment.

sentences.zh: 其方物職貢，各順土宜，出獻納貢，[10]敬依時令。

translations.literal: As for local products and official tribute, each should follow the soil's suitability; what is presented and what is delivered in tribute, [10] respectfully follow the seasons.
translations.idiomatic: Local products and official tribute should each suit the land that produces them; what is presented and what is delivered as tribute [10] must respectfully follow the seasons.

sentences.zh: 凡諸蠹俗妨民之事，趣末違本之業，雕華靡麗，奇器異技，並嚴加裁斷，務歸要實。

translations.literal: Whatever corrupt customs harm the people, pursuits of the branch that violate the root, carved ornament and extravagant beauty, strange vessels and exotic skills—all are to be strictly cut off, striving to return to what is essential and real.
translations.idiomatic: Whatever corrupt customs harm the people, whatever pursuits of luxury betray the fundamentals, whatever carved ornament, extravagant display, strange vessels, or exotic skills—all must be strictly forbidden, so that affairs may return to what is essential and real.

sentences.zh: 左右尚方御府諸署，供御制造，咸存儉約。

translations.literal: The various offices of the Left and Right Imperial Workshop and the Palace Storehouse, in supplying and manufacturing for the court—all are to preserve thrift.
translations.idiomatic: The various offices of the Left and Right Imperial Workshop and the Palace Storehouse, in supplying and manufacturing for the court, must all preserve thrift.

sentences.zh: 庶淳風至教，微遵太古，阜財興讓，少敦季俗。

translations.literal: May the pure wind of highest teaching slightly follow the Grand Antiquity; may wealth abound and yielding flourish, and the customs of our age be somewhat more restrained.
translations.idiomatic: May the pure wind of highest teaching draw somewhat nearer to Grand Antiquity; may wealth abound through yielding, and the customs of our age grow somewhat more restrained.

sentences.zh: 」又詔曰：「夫秉機詢政，[11]立教之攸本；

translations.literal: " Again an edict said: "To hold the pivot and inquire into government, [11] this is the root of establishing teaching;
translations.idiomatic: " A second edict said: "To hold the pivot of power and inquire into government [11] is the root of establishing teaching;

sentences.zh: 舉賢聘逸，弘化之所基。

translations.literal: to raise the worthy and invite the reclusive is the foundation of spreading transformation.
translations.idiomatic: to raise the worthy and invite the reclusive is the foundation of spreading civilizing influence.

sentences.zh: 故負鼎進策，殷代以康；

translations.literal: Therefore, bearing the cauldron and advancing counsel, the Yin age was thereby made secure;
translations.idiomatic: When men bore the cauldron and advanced counsel, the Yin dynasty was thereby made secure;

sentences.zh: 釋釣作輔，周祚斯乂。

translations.literal: casting off the hook and becoming assistant, the Zhou fortune was thereby set right.
translations.idiomatic: when Jiang Ziya cast off his fishing hook and became chief minister, the fortune of Zhou was set right.

sentences.zh: 朕甫承大業，訓道未敷，雖側席忠規，竚夢巖築，而良圖莫薦，奇士弗聞，永鑒通古，無忘宵寐。

translations.literal: I have just inherited the great enterprise; instruction and the Way are not yet spread abroad—though I sit sideways awaiting loyal counsel and stand in dream at Yanfu and Fuqiu, yet no excellent plan is presented, no extraordinary man is heard of; eternally taking antiquity as mirror, I do not forget vigilance through the night.
translations.idiomatic: I have only just inherited the great enterprise; instruction and the Way are not yet spread abroad—though I sit sideways awaiting loyal counsel and stand in dream beside Yanfu and Fuqiu, yet no excellent plan is presented and no extraordinary man comes to my ear; taking antiquity as my mirror, I do not forget vigilance through the night.

sentences.zh: 今藩隅克晏，敷化維始，屢懷存治，實望箴闕。

translations.literal: Now the frontier regions are at peace and spreading transformation is only beginning; repeatedly I cherish thoughts of good order and truly look to admonition for what is lacking.
translations.idiomatic: Now the frontier regions are at peace and the work of spreading transformation is only beginning; again and again I cherish the hope of good order and truly look to my ministers for admonition on what is lacking.

sentences.zh: 王公卿尹，羣僚庶官，其有嘉謀直獻，匡俗濟時，咸切事陳奏，無或依隱。

translations.literal: Princes, dukes, directors, ministers, and the multitude of officials—whoever has excellent counsel frankly presented, correcting customs and aiding the age, let all urgently set forth the matter in memorial, without concealment or evasion.
translations.idiomatic: Princes, dukes, directors, ministers, and the multitude of officials—whoever has excellent counsel to offer, correcting customs and aiding the age, let all set forth the matter urgently in memorial, without concealment or evasion.

sentences.zh: 若乃林澤貞栖，丘園耿潔，博洽古今，敦崇孝讓，四方在任，可明書搜揚，具即以聞，隨就褒立。

translations.literal: As for those of chaste dwelling in forests and marshes, of upright purity in hill gardens, broadly versed in past and present, earnestly honoring filial yielding—those in office in the four directions may clearly memorialize to search and raise them, fully report at once, and enfeoff and establish them according to merit.
translations.idiomatic: As for those of chaste dwelling in forests and marshes, of upright purity in hill and garden retirement, broadly versed in past and present, earnestly honoring filial piety and yielding—officials in office throughout the realm may memorialize clearly to search them out and raise them up, report them fully at once, and enfeoff and establish them according to merit.

sentences.zh: 」以建平王景素子延年為新安王。

translations.literal: Yannian, son of Prince Jingsu of Jianping, was made Prince of Xin'an.
translations.idiomatic: Yannian, son of Prince Jingsu of Jianping, was enfeoffed as Prince of Xin'an.

sentences.zh: 以新除左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司王玄謨為車騎將軍、南豫州刺史。

translations.literal: Newly appointed Left Grand Master of the Palace with Staff equal to Three Divisions Wang Xuanmo was made General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Southern Yu.
translations.idiomatic: Newly appointed Left Grand Master of the Palace with protocol equal to a three-division office Wang Xuanmo was appointed General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Southern Yu.

sentences.zh: 丙申，制使東土經荒流散，並各還本，蠲眾調二年。

translations.literal: On bingshen, an order was issued that those who had wandered and scattered through famine in the eastern lands should each return to their native places, and the people's levies were remitted for two years.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day an order was issued that those who had wandered and scattered through famine in the eastern lands should each return to their native places, and the people's levies were remitted for two years.

sentences.zh: 十二月己未，以尚書金部郎劉善明為冀州刺史。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, jiwei day, Director of the Gold Section Liu Shanming was made Inspector of Ji.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the jiwei day Director of the Gold Section Liu Shanming was appointed Inspector of Ji.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔曰：「近眾藩稱亂，多染釁科。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Recently the many princes declared disorder, and many were stained by criminal guilt.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "Recently many princes rose in disorder, and many were stained by criminal guilt.

sentences.zh: 或誠係本朝，事緣逼迫，混同證錮，良以悵然。

translations.literal: Some were truly bound to the dynasty, yet the affair arose from compulsion; lumped together in proof and imprisonment, I am deeply grieved thereby.
translations.idiomatic: Some were truly loyal to the dynasty, yet were driven by compulsion; lumped together in chains and imprisonment, I am deeply grieved.

sentences.zh: 夫天道尚仁，德刑並用，雷霆時至，雲雨必解。

translations.literal: The Way of Heaven esteems benevolence; virtue and punishment are employed together—when thunder arrives in season, rain clouds must surely break.
translations.idiomatic: The Way of Heaven esteems benevolence; virtue and punishment are employed together—when thunder arrives in season, the rain clouds must surely break.

sentences.zh: 朕眷言靜念，思弘風澤，凡應禁削，皆從原蕩。

translations.literal: I cherish words in silent reflection, thinking to spread wind and grace; all who should be forbidden and stripped are pardoned and cleared.
translations.idiomatic: I cherish words in silent reflection, seeking to spread grace across the realm; all who should have been forbidden or stripped of rank are pardoned and cleared.

sentences.zh: 其文武堪能，隨才銓用。

translations.literal: Those with civil and military ability shall be appointed according to their talents.
translations.idiomatic: Those with civil and military talent shall be appointed according to their abilities.

sentences.zh: 」辛未，以新除廣州刺史劉勔為益州刺史，前巴西、梓潼二郡太守費混為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: " On xinwei, newly appointed Inspector of Guang Liu Yan was made Inspector of Yi; former Interior Administrator of Brazil and Zitong commanderies Fei Hun was made Inspector of Guang.
translations.idiomatic: " On the xinwei day newly appointed Inspector of Guang Liu Yan was appointed Inspector of Yi, and former Interior Administrator of Brazil and Zitong Fei Hun was appointed Inspector of Guang.

sentences.zh: 劉勔克壽陽，豫州平。

translations.literal: Liu Yan captured Shouyang, and Yuzhou was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yan captured Shouyang and Yuzhou was pacified.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以輔國將軍劉靈遺為梁、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: On xinsi, General Who Assists the State Liu Lingyi was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day General Who Assists the State Liu Lingyi was appointed Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin.

sentences.zh: [12]薛安都要引索虜，張永、沈攸之大敗，於是遂失淮北四州及豫州淮西地。

translations.literal: [12] Xue Andu sought to bring in the Northern Wei; Zhang Yong and Shen Youzhi suffered great defeat, and thereby the four provinces north of the Huai and the lands west of the Huai in Yuzhou were lost.
translations.idiomatic: [12] Xue Andu sought to bring in Northern Wei forces; Zhang Yong and Shen Youzhi were routed, and the dynasty thereby lost the four Huai-north provinces and the Huai-western territories of Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月庚子，以農役將興，太官停宰牛。

translations.literal: Third year, spring, first month, gengzi—because agricultural labor was about to begin, the Grand Provisioner ceased slaughtering cattle.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, on gengzi day in the first month of spring, the Grand Provisioner ceased slaughtering cattle because agricultural labor was about to begin.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，曲赦豫、南豫二州。

translations.literal: On guimao, a partial amnesty was granted for Yu and Southern Yu provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day a partial amnesty was granted for Yu and Southern Yu provinces.

sentences.zh: 衞將軍巴陵王休若降號鎮西將軍。

translations.literal: General of the Guard Prince Xiuruo of Baling was demoted to General Who Guards the West.
translations.idiomatic: General of the Guard Prince Xiuruo of Baling was demoted to General Who Guards the West.

sentences.zh: 閏月庚午，京師大雨雪，遣使巡行，賑賜各有差。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, gengwu day—great rain and snow fell in the capital; envoys were dispatched to tour and inspect, with relief and gifts according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on gengwu day, heavy rain and snow fell in the capital; envoys were sent to tour the affected areas and distribute relief according to rank.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以游擊將軍垣閎為益州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuyin, General Who Attacks in Mobile Warfare Yuan Hong was made Inspector of Yi.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day General Who Attacks in Mobile Warfare Yuan Hong was appointed Inspector of Yi.

translations.literal: [13] Editorial note thirteen stands in the received text at this point in the narrative.
translations.idiomatic: [13] Editorial note thirteen stands in the received text at this point in the narrative.

sentences.zh: 二月甲申，以御史中丞羊希為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: Second month, jiashen day, Censor-in-Chief Yang Xi was made Inspector of Guang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the jiashen day Censor-in-Chief Yang Xi was appointed Inspector of Guang.

sentences.zh: [14]是日，車駕為戰亡將士舉哀。

translations.literal: [14] That day the imperial carriage held mourning for officers and soldiers who died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: [14] That day the emperor held mourning rites for officers and soldiers who died in battle.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以鎮西司馬劉亮為梁、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: On jichou, Chief Clerk of the General Who Guards the West Liu Liang was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day Chief Clerk of the General Who Guards the West Liu Liang was appointed Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin.

sentences.zh: 索虜寇汝陰，太守張景遠擊破之。

translations.literal: The Northern Wei raided Ruyin; Administrator Zhang Jingyuan repulsed and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Wei forces raided Ruyin; Administrator Zhang Jingyuan repulsed and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 丙申，曲赦青、冀二州。

translations.literal: On bingshen, a partial amnesty was granted for Qing and Ji provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day a partial amnesty was granted for Qing and Ji provinces.

sentences.zh: 三月丙子，以尚書左僕射蔡興宗為安西將軍、郢州刺史。

translations.literal: Third month, bingzi day, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Cai Xingzong was made General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Ying.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the bingzi day Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Cai Xingzong was appointed General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Ying.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以冠軍將軍王玄載為徐州刺史，寧朔將軍崔平為兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuyin, General Who Conquers Wang Xuandai was made Inspector of Xu; General Who Pacifies the North Cui Ping was made Inspector of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day General Who Conquers Wang Xuandai was appointed Inspector of Xu, and General Who Pacifies the North Cui Ping was appointed Inspector of Yan.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸巳，以前司州刺史鄭黑為司州刺史。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, guisi day, former Inspector of Si Zheng Hei was made Inspector of Si.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the guisi day former Inspector of Si Zheng Hei was appointed Inspector of Si.

sentences.zh: 乙未，冠軍將軍、北秦州刺史楊僧嗣進號征西將軍。

translations.literal: On yiwei, General Who Conquers and Inspector of Northern Qin Yang Sengsi was promoted to General Who Conquers the West.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day General Who Conquers and Inspector of Northern Qin Yang Sengsi was promoted to General Who Conquers the West.

sentences.zh: 庚子，立桂陽王休範第二子德嗣為廬陵王，立侍中劉韞第二子銑為南豐王。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Desi, second son of Prince Xiufan of Guiyang, was established as Prince of Luling; Miao, second son of Attendant-in-Ordinary Liu Yun, was established as Prince of Nanfeng.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day Desi, second son of Prince Xiufan of Guiyang, was enfeoffed as Prince of Luling, and Miao, second son of Attendant-in-Ordinary Liu Yun, was enfeoffed as Prince of Nanfeng.

sentences.zh: 丙午，安西將軍蔡興宗降號平西將軍。

translations.literal: On bingwu, General Who Pacifies the West Cai Xingzong was demoted to General Who Levels the West.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day General Who Pacifies the West Cai Xingzong was demoted to General Who Levels the West.

sentences.zh: 五月丙辰，宣太后崇寧陵禁內墳屋瘞遷徙者，給葬直，蠲復家丁。

translations.literal: Fifth month, bingchen day—within the forbidden precinct of Empress Dowager Chongning's tomb, those whose burial chambers had been relocated were given funeral expenses, and household corvée was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the bingchen day, within the forbidden precinct of Empress Dowager Chongning's tomb those whose burial chambers had been relocated were given funeral expenses and their households were exempted from corvée.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以車騎將軍、南豫州刺史王玄謨為左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On wuwu, General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Southern Yuzhou Wang Xuamo was made Left Grand Master of the Palace with Staff equal to Three Divisions.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Southern Yuzhou Wang Xuamo was appointed Left Grand Master of the Palace with protocol equal to a three-division office.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，罷南豫州并豫州。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Southern Yuzhou was abolished and merged into Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day Southern Yuzhou was abolished and merged into Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以太子詹事袁粲為尚書僕射。

translations.literal: On renxu, Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent Yuan Can was made Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent Yuan Can was appointed Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 六月乙酉，以侍中劉韞為湘州刺史。

translations.literal: Sixth month, yiyou day, Attendant-in-Ordinary Liu Yun was made Inspector of Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the yiyou day Attendant-in-Ordinary Liu Yun was appointed Inspector of Xiang.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬子，以左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司王玄謨為特進、左光祿大夫、護軍將軍。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, renzi day, Left Grand Master of the Palace with Staff equal to Three Divisions Wang Xuamo was made Special Grand Master, Left Grand Master of the Palace, and General Who Protects the Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the renzi day Left Grand Master of the Palace with protocol equal to a three-division office Wang Xuamo was made Special Grand Master, Left Grand Master of the Palace, and General Who Protects the Army.

sentences.zh: 薛安都子伯令略據雍州四郡，刺史巴陵王休若討斬之。
