translations.literal: Xue Andu's son Boling briefly held the four commanderies of Yongzhou; Inspector Prince Xiuruo of Baling attacked and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Andu's son Boling briefly seized the four commanderies of Yongzhou; Inspector Prince Xiuruo of Baling attacked and executed him.

sentences.zh: 八月丁酉，詔曰：「古者衡虞置制，蝝蚳不收；

translations.literal: Eighth month, dingyou day, an edict said: "In antiquity the keepers of the mountains and marshes established regulations, and even tiny creatures were not gathered;
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the dingyou day, an edict said: "In antiquity the keepers of mountains and marshes established regulations, and even the smallest creatures were not gathered;

sentences.zh: 川澤產育，登器進御。

translations.literal: what rivers and marshes produced was presented for the imperial table.
translations.idiomatic: what rivers and marshes produced was presented for the imperial table.

sentences.zh: 所以繁阜民財，養遂生德。

translations.literal: This was to enrich the people's wealth and nurture the virtue of sustaining life.
translations.idiomatic: This was to enrich the people's wealth and nurture the virtue of sustaining life.

sentences.zh: 頃商販逐末，競早爭新，折未實之菓，收豪家之利，籠非膳之翼，為戲童之資。

translations.literal: Recently merchants pursued profit, competing to harvest early and rush the new; they plucked unripe fruit and seized great families' gains, caged creatures unfit for the table, and made them resources for childish amusements.
translations.idiomatic: Recently merchants pursued profit, competing to harvest early and rush the new; they plucked unripe fruit to seize profits from great households, caged creatures unfit for the table, and made them playthings for children.

sentences.zh: 豈所以還風尚本，捐華務實。

translations.literal: How can this restore custom and honor the root, discard ornament and pursue substance?
translations.idiomatic: How can this restore custom, honor the root, discard ornament, and pursue substance?

sentences.zh: 宜修道布仁，以革斯蠹。

translations.literal: It is fitting to cultivate the Way and spread benevolence, to reform this corruption.
translations.idiomatic: It is fitting to cultivate the Way and spread benevolence to reform this corruption.

sentences.zh: 自今鱗介羽毛，肴核眾品，非時月可採，器味所須，可一皆禁斷，嚴為科制。

translations.literal: From now on, fish, shellfish, feathers, furs, fruits, and the many delicacies—not to be gathered out of season, nor needed for vessels and flavors—are all forbidden without exception, with strict statutes established.
translations.idiomatic: From now on fish, shellfish, feathers, furs, fruits, and other delicacies that are not in season and not required for vessels or flavor are all strictly forbidden, with rigorous statutes established.

sentences.zh: 」壬寅，以中領軍沈攸之行南兗州刺史，率眾北討。

translations.literal: " On renyin, General of the Palace Guard Shen Youzhi acted as Inspector of Southern Yan and led troops north to attack.
translations.idiomatic: " On the renyin day General of the Palace Guard Shen Youzhi served as Inspector of Southern Yan and led troops north to campaign.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，詔曰：「法網之用，期世而行，寬惠之道，因時而布。

translations.literal: On guimao, an edict said: "The use of the legal net is expected to endure through the ages; the way of leniency and grace is deployed according to the times.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day an edict said: "The use of the legal net is meant to endure through the ages; the way of leniency and grace is deployed according to the times.

sentences.zh: 況朕尚德戡亂，依仁馭俗，宜每就弘簡，以隆至治。

translations.literal: Moreover I esteem virtue in quelling disorder and rely on benevolence to govern custom; it is fitting always to pursue broad simplicity, to exalt the utmost governance.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover I esteem virtue in quelling disorder and rely on benevolence to govern custom; it is fitting always to pursue broad simplicity and exalt the utmost governance.

sentences.zh: 而頻罹兵革，繇賦未休，軍民巧偽，興事甚多，蹈刑入憲，諒非一科。

translations.literal: Yet repeatedly afflicted by warfare, taxes and corvée have not ceased; soldiers and commoners employ cunning and artifice, and affairs arising are very numerous; those who tread the law and enter punishment are surely not of one category alone.
translations.idiomatic: Yet repeatedly afflicted by warfare, taxes and corvée have not ceased; soldiers and commoners employ cunning and artifice, and the affairs arising are very numerous; those who tread the law and enter punishment are surely not of one category alone.

sentences.zh: 至乃假名戎伍，竊爵私庭，因戰散亡，託懼逃役。

translations.literal: Even to the point of falsely assuming military names, stealing ranks in private households, and because of battle scattering and perishing, using fear to excuse flight from corvée.
translations.idiomatic: Some even falsely assumed military names, stole ranks in private households, and because of battle scattering and death used fear as a pretext to flee corvée.

sentences.zh: 且往諸淪逼，雖經累宥，逋竄之黨，猶為實繁。

translations.literal: Moreover those who in the past were overrun and coerced, though having passed through repeated amnesties, the bands of fugitives are still truly numerous.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover those who in the past were overrun and coerced, though having passed through repeated amnesties, the bands of fugitives remain truly numerous.

sentences.zh: 宵言永懷，良兼矜疚。

translations.literal: Night words and long brooding—truly I am also filled with compassionate grief.
translations.idiomatic: Brooding day and night, I am truly filled with compassionate grief.

sentences.zh: 思所以重播至澤，覃被區宇。

translations.literal: I think to again spread the utmost grace and extend it over the realm.
translations.idiomatic: I therefore seek again to spread the utmost grace and extend it over the realm.

sentences.zh: 可大赦天下。

translations.literal: A great amnesty may be granted throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: A great amnesty is granted throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 」加新除左光祿大夫王玄謨車騎將軍。

translations.literal: Newly appointed Left Grand Master of the Palace Wang Xuamo was additionally made General of Chariots and Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Newly appointed Left Grand Master of the Palace Wang Xuamo was additionally appointed General of Chariots and Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 丙午，遣吏部尚書褚淵慰勞緣淮將帥，隨宜量賜。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Minister of Personnel Chu Yuan was dispatched to comfort and reward commanders along the Huai, with gifts according to circumstances.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day Minister of Personnel Chu Yuan was dispatched to comfort and reward commanders along the Huai, with gifts according to circumstances.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以新除右衞將軍劉勔為豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On wushen, newly appointed General of the Right Guard Liu Yan was made Inspector of Yu.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day newly appointed General of the Right Guard Liu Yan was appointed Inspector of Yu.

sentences.zh: 九月癸丑，鎮西將軍、雍州刺史巴陵王休若進號衞將軍，平西將軍、郢州刺史蔡興宗進號安西將軍。

translations.literal: Ninth month, guichou day, General Who Guards the West and Inspector of Yong Prince Xiuruo of Baling was promoted to General of the Guard; General Who Levels the West and Inspector of Ying Cai Xingzong was promoted to General Who Pacifies the West.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the guichou day General Who Guards the West and Inspector of Yong Prince Xiuruo of Baling was promoted to General of the Guard, and General Who Levels the West and Inspector of Ying Cai Xingzong was promoted to General Who Pacifies the West.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以越騎校尉周寧民為兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On yimao, Commandant of Rapid Cavalry Zhou Ningmin was made Inspector of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day Commandant of Rapid Cavalry Zhou Ningmin was appointed Inspector of Yan.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以皇后六宮以下雜衣千領，金釵千枚，班賜北征將士。

translations.literal: On wuwu, one thousand sets of miscellaneous garments for the empress and the six palaces and below, and one thousand gold hairpins, were distributed to northern campaign officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day one thousand sets of miscellaneous garments for the empress and the six palaces and below, and one thousand gold hairpins, were distributed to officers and soldiers on the northern campaign.

sentences.zh: 庚申，前將軍兼冀州刺史崔道固進號平北將軍。

translations.literal: On gengshen, former General and concurrent Inspector of Ji Cui Daogu was promoted to General Who Levels the North.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day former General and concurrent Inspector of Ji Cui Daogu was promoted to General Who Levels the North.

sentences.zh: 甲子，曲赦徐、兗、青、冀四州。

translations.literal: On jiazi, a partial amnesty was granted for Xu, Yan, Qing, and Ji provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day a partial amnesty was granted for Xu, Yan, Qing, and Ji provinces.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬午，改封新安王延年為始平王。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, renwu day, Prince Yannian of Xin'an was changed to Prince of Shiping.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the renwu day Prince Yannian of Xin'an was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Shiping.

sentences.zh: 戊子，芮芮國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On wuzi, the Rouran state sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day the Rouran state sent envoys presenting tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，復郡縣公田。

translations.literal: On xinchou, public fields of commanderies and counties were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day public fields of commanderies and counties were restored.

sentences.zh: 鎮西大將軍、西秦河二州刺史吐谷渾拾寅進號征西大將軍。

translations.literal: General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Western Qin and He Tuyuhun Shibin was promoted to General-in-Chief Who Conquers the West.
translations.idiomatic: General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Western Qin and He Tuyuhun Shibin was promoted to General-in-Chief Who Conquers the West.

sentences.zh: 十一月，立建安王休仁第二子伯猷為江夏王，改封義陽王昶為晉熙王。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, Boyou, second son of Prince Xiuren of Jian'an, was established as Prince of Jiangxia; Prince Chang of Yiyang was changed to Prince of Jinxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Boyou, second son of Prince Xiuren of Jian'an, was enfeoffed as Prince of Jiangxia, and Prince Chang of Yiyang was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Jinxi.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，分徐州置東徐州，以輔國將軍張讜為刺史。

translations.literal: On yimao, Eastern Xuzhou was established by dividing Xuzhou; General Who Assists the State Zhang Dan was made Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day Eastern Xuzhou was established by dividing Xuzhou, and General Who Assists the State Zhang Dan was appointed Inspector.

sentences.zh: 高麗國、百濟國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: The states of Goguryeo and Baekje sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: The states of Goguryeo and Baekje sent envoys presenting tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚辰，以寧朔將軍劉休賓為兗州刺史。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, gengchen day, General Who Pacifies the North Liu Xiubin was made Inspector of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the gengchen day General Who Pacifies the North Liu Xiubin was appointed Inspector of Yan.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月己未，車駕親祠南郊，大赦天下。

translations.literal: Fourth year, spring, first month, jiwei day, the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the Southern Suburban Altar; a great amnesty was granted throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, on jiwei day in the first month of spring, the emperor personally sacrificed at the Southern Suburban Altar and granted a great amnesty throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 庚午，衞將軍巴陵王休若降號左將軍。

translations.literal: On gengwu, General of the Guard Prince Xiuruo of Baling was demoted to General of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day General of the Guard Prince Xiuruo of Baling was demoted to General of the Left.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，零陵王司馬勗薨。

translations.literal: On yihai, Sima Xun, Military Supervisor of the Prince of Lingling, died.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day Sima Xun, Military Supervisor of the Prince of Lingling, died.

sentences.zh: 二月辛丑，以前龍驤將軍常珍奇為平北將軍、司州刺史，珍奇子超越為北冀州刺史。

translations.literal: Second month, xinchou day, former General of Flying Cavalry Chang Zhenqi was made General Who Levels the North and Inspector of Si; Zhenqi's son Chaoyue was made Inspector of Northern Ji.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the xinchou day former General of Flying Cavalry Chang Zhenqi was appointed General Who Levels the North and Inspector of Si, and Zhenqi's son Chaoyue was appointed Inspector of Northern Ji.

sentences.zh: [15]乙巳，右光祿大夫、車騎將軍、護軍將軍王玄謨薨。

translations.literal: [15] On yisi, Right Grand Master of the Palace, General of Chariots and Cavalry, and General Who Protects the Army Wang Xuamo died.
translations.idiomatic: [15] On the yisi day Right Grand Master of the Palace, General of Chariots and Cavalry, and General Who Protects the Army Wang Xuamo died.

translations.literal: [16] Editorial note sixteen stands in the received text at this point in the narrative.
translations.idiomatic: [16] Editorial note sixteen stands in the received text at this point in the narrative.

sentences.zh: 三月己未，[17]以游擊將軍劉懷珍為東徐州刺史。

translations.literal: Third month, jiwei day, [17] General Who Attacks in Mobile Warfare Liu Huaizhen was made Inspector of Eastern Xu.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the jiwei day, [17] General Who Attacks in Mobile Warfare Liu Huaizhen was appointed Inspector of Eastern Xu.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以軍司馬劉靈遺為梁、南秦二州刺史，[18]南譙太守孫奉伯為交州刺史，[19]交州人李長仁據州叛。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Army Supervisor Liu Lingyi was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin, [18] Interior Administrator of Southern Qiao Sun Fengbo was made Inspector of Jiao, [19] and the man of Jiao Li Changren seized the province in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day Army Supervisor Liu Lingyi was appointed Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin, [18] Interior Administrator of Southern Qiao Sun Fengbo was appointed Inspector of Jiao, [19] and Li Changren of Jiao seized the province in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 妖賊攻廣州，殺刺史羊希，[20]龍驤將軍陳伯紹討平之。

translations.literal: Demonic bandits attacked Guangzhou and killed Inspector Yang Xi; [20] General of Flying Cavalry Chen Bozhao attacked and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel bandits attacked Guangzhou and killed Inspector Yang Xi; [20] General of Flying Cavalry Chen Bozhao attacked and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己卯，復減郡縣田祿之半。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, jimao day, the half of commandery and county field salaries was again reduced.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the jimao day, commandery and county field salaries were again reduced by half.

sentences.zh: [21]丙申，東海王褘改封廬江王，[22]山陽王休祐改封晉平王，改晉安郡為晉平郡。

translations.literal: [21] On bingshen, Prince Hui of Donghai was changed to Prince of Lujiang; [22] Prince Xiuyou of Shanyang was changed to Prince of Jinping, and Jin'an commandery was changed to Jinping commandery.
translations.idiomatic: [21] On the bingshen day Prince Hui of Donghai was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Lujiang; [22] Prince Xiuyou of Shanyang was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Jinping, and Jin'an commandery was renamed Jinping commandery.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，芮芮國及河南王並遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On xinchou, the Rouran state and the King of Henan both sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day the Rouran state and the King of Henan both sent envoys presenting tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以豫章太守張辯為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Administrator of Yuzhang Zhang Bian was made Inspector of Guang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day Administrator of Yuzhang Zhang Bian was appointed Inspector of Guang.

sentences.zh: 五月乙巳，[23]曲赦廣州。

translations.literal: Fifth month, yisi day, [23] a partial amnesty was granted for Guang province.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the yisi day, [23] a partial amnesty was granted for Guang province.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以行雍州刺史巴陵王休若行湘州刺史，會稽太守張永為雍州刺史，湘州刺史劉韞為南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On guihai, Prince Xiuruo of Baling acting as Inspector of Yong was made acting Inspector of Xiang; Administrator of Kuaiji Zhang Yong was made Inspector of Yong; Inspector of Xiang Liu Yun was made Inspector of Southern Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day Prince Xiuruo of Baling, acting as Inspector of Yong, was made acting Inspector of Xiang; Administrator of Kuaiji Zhang Yong was appointed Inspector of Yong; and Inspector of Xiang Liu Yun was appointed Inspector of Southern Yan.

sentences.zh: 八月戊子，以南康相劉勃為交州刺史。

translations.literal: Eighth month, wuzi day, Chancellor of Nankang Liu Bo was made Inspector of Jiao.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the wuzi day Chancellor of Nankang Liu Bo was appointed Inspector of Jiao.

sentences.zh: [24]辛卯，分青州置東青州，以輔國將軍沈文靖為東青州刺史。

translations.literal: [24] On xinmao, Eastern Qing province was established by dividing Qing province; General Who Assists the State Shen Wenjing was made Inspector of Eastern Qing.
translations.idiomatic: [24] On the xinmao day Eastern Qing province was established by dividing Qing province, and General Who Assists the State Shen Wenjing was appointed Inspector of Eastern Qing.

sentences.zh: [25]丁酉，安南將軍、江州刺史王景文進號鎮南將軍。

translations.literal: [25] On dingyou, General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of Jiang Wang Jingwen was promoted to General Who Pacifies the South.
translations.idiomatic: [25] On the dingyou day General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of Jiang Wang Jingwen was promoted to General Who Pacifies the South.

sentences.zh: 九月丙辰，以驃騎長史張悅為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: Ninth month, bingchen day, Chief Clerk of the General-in-Chief Who Runs Fast Zhang Yue was made Inspector of Yong.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the bingchen day Chief Clerk of the General-in-Chief Who Runs Fast Zhang Yue was appointed Inspector of Yong.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔曰：「夫愆有小大，憲隨寬猛，故五刑殊用，三典異施。

translations.literal: On wuchen, an edict said: "Offenses have small and great; punishment follows leniency or severity—therefore the five punishments differ in use and the three codes differ in application.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day an edict said: "Offenses have small and great; punishment follows leniency or severity—therefore the five punishments differ in use and the three codes differ in application.

sentences.zh: 而降辟次網，便暨鉗撻，求之法科，差品滋遠。

translations.literal: Yet when reduced punishments follow the secondary net, one arrives at shackles and flogging; seeking this in the law code, the gradations of rank grow ever more distant.
translations.idiomatic: Yet when reduced punishments follow the secondary net, one arrives at shackles and flogging; seeking this in the law code, the gradations of rank grow ever more distant.

sentences.zh: 朕務存欽卹，每有矜貸。

translations.literal: I strive to preserve reverent compassion and always show merciful remission.
translations.idiomatic: I strive to preserve reverent compassion and always show merciful remission.

sentences.zh: 尋劫制科罪，[26]輕重同之大辟，即事原情，未為詳衷。

translations.literal: Examining robbery under the statutory code, [26] the light and heavy alike reach the great execution—yet judging the matter by the facts, this is not a detailed and balanced measure.
translations.idiomatic: Examining robbery under the statutory code, [26] light and heavy offenses alike reach capital punishment—yet judging the matter by the facts, this is not a detailed and balanced measure.

sentences.zh: 自今凡竊執官仗，拒戰邏司，或攻剽亭寺，及害吏民者，凡此諸條，悉依舊制。

translations.literal: From now on, all who forcibly seize official weapons, resist battle and patrol officials, or attack and plunder post stations and temples and harm officials and commoners—all such articles shall follow the old statutes.
translations.idiomatic: From now on, all who forcibly seize official weapons, resist battle and patrol officials, or attack and plunder post stations and temples and harm officials and commoners—all such offenses shall follow the old statutes.

sentences.zh: 五人以下相逼奪者，可特賜黥刖，投畀四遠，仍用代殺，方古為優，全命長戶，施同造物。

translations.literal: Those who in groups of five or fewer forcibly seize from one another may be specially granted tattooing and mutilation, sent to the four distant regions, still using substitution for execution—in comparison with antiquity this is lenient, preserving life and long household service, a grace equal to creation itself.
translations.idiomatic: Those who in groups of five or fewer forcibly seize from one another may be specially sentenced to tattooing and mutilation and sent to the four distant regions, still using substitution for execution—in comparison with antiquity this is lenient, preserving life and long household service, a grace equal to creation itself.

sentences.zh: 庶簡惠之化，有孚羣萌，好生之德，無漏幽品。

translations.literal: May the transformation of simplicity and grace have sincerity toward the multitude of the living; the virtue of cherishing life be without leak toward the hidden ranks.
translations.idiomatic: May the transformation of simplicity and grace win the trust of the living multitude; may the virtue of cherishing life reach even the hidden ranks.

sentences.zh: 」庚午，曲赦揚、南徐、兗、豫四州。

translations.literal: " On gengwu, a partial amnesty was granted for Yang, Southern Xu, Yan, and Yu provinces.
translations.idiomatic: " On the gengwu day a partial amnesty was granted for Yang, Southern Xu, Yan, and Yu provinces.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸酉朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, guiyou first day of new moon—there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the guiyou day, the first of the month, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 發諸州兵北討。

translations.literal: Troops of the various provinces were mobilized for the northern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Troops from the various provinces were mobilized for the northern campaign.

sentences.zh: 南康、建安、安成、宣城四郡，昔不同南逆，並不在徵發之例。

translations.literal: The four commanderies of Nankang, Jian'an, Ancheng, and Xuancheng in the past did not join the southern rebellion and were all outside the scope of conscription.
translations.idiomatic: The four commanderies of Nankang, Jian'an, Ancheng, and Xuancheng had not joined the southern rebellion and were all exempt from conscription.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，割揚州之義興郡屬南徐州。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Yixing commandery of Yang province was detached and placed under Southern Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day Yixing commandery of Yang province was detached and placed under Southern Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月癸亥，車駕躬耕藉田。

translations.literal: Fifth year, spring, first month, guihai day, the imperial carriage personally plowed the ceremonial field.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, on guihai day in the first month of spring, the emperor personally plowed the ceremonial field.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下，賜力田爵一級。

translations.literal: A great amnesty was granted throughout the realm; those who tilled fields diligently were granted one rank of nobility.
translations.idiomatic: A great amnesty was granted throughout the realm, and diligent field-tillers were granted one rank of nobility.

sentences.zh: 二月丙申，分豫州、揚州立南豫州，以太尉廬江王褘為車騎將軍，開府儀同三司、南豫州刺史。

translations.literal: Second month, bingshen day, Southern Yuzhou was established by dividing Yuzhou and Yang province; Grand Marshal Prince Hui of Lujiang was made General of Chariots and Cavalry with Staff equal to Three Divisions and Inspector of Southern Yu.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the bingshen day Southern Yuzhou was established by dividing Yuzhou and Yang province; Grand Marshal Prince Hui of Lujiang was appointed General of Chariots and Cavalry with protocol equal to a three-division office and Inspector of Southern Yu.

sentences.zh: 三月乙卯，於南豫州立南義陽郡。

translations.literal: Third month, yimao day, Southern Yiyang commandery was established within Southern Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the yimao day Southern Yiyang commandery was established within Southern Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，車駕幸中堂聽訟。

translations.literal: On bingyin, the imperial carriage visited the Central Hall to hear lawsuits.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day the emperor visited the Central Hall to hear lawsuits.

sentences.zh: 己巳，河南王遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On jisi, the King of Henan sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day the King of Henan sent envoys presenting tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛未，割雍州隨郡屬郢州。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, xinwei day, Suicheng commandery of Yong province was detached and placed under Ying province.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the xinwei day Suicheng commandery of Yong province was detached and placed under Ying province.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，割豫州義陽郡屬郢州，郢州西陽郡屬豫州。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Yiyang commandery of Yuzhou was detached and placed under Ying province; Xiyang commandery of Ying province was placed under Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day Yiyang commandery of Yuzhou was detached and placed under Ying province, and Xiyang commandery of Ying province was placed under Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以寧朔將軍崔公烈為兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuzi, General Who Tranquilizes the North Cui Gonglie was made Inspector of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day General Who Tranquilizes the North Cui Gonglie was appointed Inspector of Yan.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，新除給事黃門侍郎杜幼文為梁、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuxu, newly appointed Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate Du Youwen was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day newly appointed Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate Du Youwen was appointed Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin.

sentences.zh: 六月辛未，立晉平王休祐子宣曜為南平王。

translations.literal: Sixth month, xinwei day, Xuanyao, son of Prince Xiuyou of Jinping, was established as Prince of Nanping.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the xinwei day Xuanyao, son of Prince Xiuyou of Jinping, was enfeoffed as Prince of Nanping.

sentences.zh: [27]壬申，以安西將軍、郢州刺史蔡興宗為鎮東將軍。

translations.literal: [27] On renshen, General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Ying Cai Xingzong was made General Who Pacifies the East.
translations.idiomatic: [27] On the renshen day General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Ying Cai Xingzong was appointed General Who Pacifies the East.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以左衞將軍沈攸之為郢州刺史。

translations.literal: On guiyou, General of the Left Guard Shen Youzhi was made Inspector of Ying.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day General of the Left Guard Shen Youzhi was appointed Inspector of Ying.

sentences.zh: 以軍興已來，百官斷俸，並給生食。

translations.literal: Because military campaigns had been underway, all officials had had their salaries cut off, and only raw stipends were provided.
translations.idiomatic: Because military campaigns had been underway, all officials had had their salaries suspended and were given only raw stipends.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，車騎將軍、南豫州刺史廬江王褘免官爵。

translations.literal: On dingchou, General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Southern Yu Prince Hui of Lujiang was stripped of office and rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Southern Yu Prince Hui of Lujiang was stripped of office and rank.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以左將軍、行湘州刺史巴陵王休若為征南將軍、湘州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuyin, General of the Left and Acting Inspector of Xiang Prince Xiuruo of Baling was made General Who Conquers the South and Inspector of Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day General of the Left and Acting Inspector of Xiang Prince Xiuruo of Baling was appointed General Who Conquers the South and Inspector of Xiang.

sentences.zh: 壬午，罷南豫州。

translations.literal: On renwu, Southern Yu province was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day Southern Yu province was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以新除給事黃門侍郎劉亮為益州刺史。

translations.literal: On bingxu, newly appointed Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate Liu Liang was made Inspector of Yi.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day newly appointed Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate Liu Liang was appointed Inspector of Yi.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己酉，以輔國將軍王亮為徐州刺史，東莞太守陳伯紹為交州刺史。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, jiyou day, General Who Assists the State Wang Liang was made Inspector of Xu; Administrator of Dongguan Chen Bozhao was made Inspector of Jiao.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the jiyou day General Who Assists the State Wang Liang was appointed Inspector of Xu, and Administrator of Dongguan Chen Bozhao was appointed Inspector of Jiao.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以山陽太守李靈謙為兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Administrator of Shanyang Li Lingqian was made Inspector of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day Administrator of Shanyang Li Lingqian was appointed Inspector of Yan.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，改輔國將軍為輔師將軍。

translations.literal: On renxu, General Who Assists the State was renamed General Who Assists the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day General Who Assists the State was renamed General Who Assists the Army.

sentences.zh: 八月己丑，以右將軍行豫州刺史劉勔為平西將軍、豫州刺史。

translations.literal: Eighth month, jichou day, General of the Right and Acting Inspector of Yu Liu Mian was made General Who Levels the West and Inspector of Yu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the jichou day General of the Right and Acting Inspector of Yu Liu Mian was appointed General Who Levels the West and Inspector of Yu.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以海陵太守劉崇智為冀州刺史。

translations.literal: On renchen, Administrator of Hailing Liu Chongzhi was made Inspector of Ji.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day Administrator of Hailing Liu Chongzhi was appointed Inspector of Ji.

sentences.zh: 九月甲寅，立長沙王纂子延之為始平王。

translations.literal: Ninth month, jiayin day, Yanzhi, son of Prince Zuan of Changsha, was established as Prince of Shiping.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the jiayin day Yanzhi, son of Prince Zuan of Changsha, was enfeoffed as Prince of Shiping.

sentences.zh: 戊午，中領軍王琨遷職。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Central Army Commander Wang Kun was transferred from his post.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day Central Army Commander Wang Kun was transferred from his post.

sentences.zh: 己未，詔曰：「夫箕、潁之操，振古所貴，沖素之風，哲王攸重。

translations.literal: On jiwei, an edict said: "The integrity of Jizi and Yingbo has been prized since antiquity; the spirit of pure simplicity is what wise kings hold in highest regard.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day an edict said: "The integrity of Jizi and Yingbo has been prized since antiquity; the spirit of pure simplicity is what wise kings hold in highest regard.

sentences.zh: 朕屬橫流之會，接難晦之辰，龕暴剪亂，日不暇給。

translations.literal: I came to the throne amid flowing turmoil and at a dark hour of hardship, pacifying violence and cutting down disorder with scarcely a moment's rest.
translations.idiomatic: I came to the throne amid flowing turmoil and at a dark hour of hardship, pacifying violence and cutting down disorder with scarcely a moment to spare.

sentences.zh: 今雖關、隴猶靄，區縣澄氛，偃武修文，於是乎在。

translations.literal: Now though the passes of Guan and Long still lie in haze, districts and counties are clearing, and the time has come to lay down arms and cultivate culture.
translations.idiomatic: Now though the passes of Guan and Long still lie in haze, districts and counties are clearing, and the time has come to lay down arms and cultivate culture.

sentences.zh: 思崇廉耻，用靜馳薄，固已物色載懷，寢興竚歎。

translations.literal: Seeking to elevate integrity and shame, to still the rushing tide of shallow pursuit, I have long kept such men in mind, sighing day and night as I rise and lie down.
translations.idiomatic: Seeking to elevate integrity and shame and still the rushing tide of shallow pursuit, I have long kept such men in mind, sighing day and night as I rise and lie down.

sentences.zh: 其有貞栖隱約，息事衡樊，[28]鑿坏遺榮，負釣辭聘，志恬江海，行高塵俗者，在所精加搜括，時以名聞。

translations.literal: Those who dwell in steadfast seclusion, rest from affairs behind their gate, [28] break their wall and abandon glory, fish in solitude and decline office, whose hearts find peace in rivers and seas and whose conduct rises above the vulgar—let every locality diligently search them out and report their names in season.
translations.idiomatic: Those who dwell in steadfast seclusion, rest from affairs behind their gate, [28] break their wall and abandon glory, fish in solitude and decline office, whose hearts find peace in rivers and seas and whose conduct rises above the vulgar—let every locality diligently search them out and report their names in due season.

sentences.zh: 將賁園矜德，茂昭厥禮。

translations.literal: They shall be honored with estates and their virtue extolled, and their rites richly displayed.
translations.idiomatic: They shall be honored with estates, their virtue extolled, and their rites richly displayed.

sentences.zh: 羣司各舉所知，以時授爵。

translations.literal: All offices shall each recommend those they know and confer rank in due season.
translations.idiomatic: All offices shall each recommend those they know and confer rank in due season.

sentences.zh: 」乙丑，以新除平西將軍、豫州刺史劉勔為中領軍。

translations.literal: " On yichou, newly appointed General Who Levels the West and Inspector of Yu Liu Mian was made Central Army Commander.
translations.idiomatic: " On the yichou day newly appointed General Who Levels the West and Inspector of Yu Liu Mian was appointed Central Army Commander.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁卯朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on the dingmao day at new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the dingmao day at new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁未，索虜遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, dingwei day, the Northern Wei sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the dingwei day, Northern Wei envoys presented tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 閏月戊子，驃騎大將軍、荊州刺史晉平王休祐以本號為南徐州刺史，征南將軍、湘州刺史巴陵王休若為征西將軍、荊州刺史，輔師將軍孟次陽為兗州刺史，[29]義陽太守呂安國為司州刺史。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, wuzi day, Grand General of Agile Cavalry and Inspector of Jing Prince Xiuyou of Jinping retained his title and became Inspector of Southern Xu; General Who Conquers the South and Inspector of Xiang Prince Xiuruo of Baling was made General Who Conquers the West and Inspector of Jing; General Who Assists the Army Meng Ciyang was made Inspector of Yan; [29] Administrator of Yiyang Lu Anguo was made Inspector of Si.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the wuzi day Grand General of Agile Cavalry and Inspector of Jing Prince Xiuyou of Jinping retained his title and became Inspector of Southern Xu; General Who Conquers the South and Inspector of Xiang Prince Xiuruo of Baling was appointed General Who Conquers the West and Inspector of Jing; General Who Assists the Army Meng Ciyang was appointed Inspector of Yan; [29] Administrator of Yiyang Lu Anguo was appointed Inspector of Si.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊戌，司徒建安王休仁解揚州刺史。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, wuxu day, Chancellor Prince Xiuren of Jian'an relinquished his post as Inspector of Yang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the wuxu day Chancellor Prince Xiuren of Jian'an relinquished his post as Inspector of Yang.

sentences.zh: 己未，以征北大將軍、南徐州刺史桂陽王休範為中書監、中軍將軍、揚州刺史，[30]吳興太守建平王景素為湘州刺史，輔師將軍建安王世子伯融為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiwei, General Who Conquers the North and Inspector of Southern Xu Prince Xiufan of Guiyang was made Director of the Central Secretariat, General of the Central Army, and Inspector of Yang; [30] Administrator of Wuxing Prince Jingsu of Jianping was made Inspector of Xiang; Heir of Prince Xiuren of Jian'an, the General Who Assists the Army Bo Rong, was made Inspector of Guang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day General Who Conquers the North and Inspector of Southern Xu Prince Xiufan of Guiyang was appointed Director of the Central Secretariat, General of the Central Army, and Inspector of Yang; [30] Administrator of Wuxing Prince Jingsu of Jianping was appointed Inspector of Xiang; Heir of Prince Xiuren of Jian'an and General Who Assists the Army Bo Rong was appointed Inspector of Guang.

sentences.zh: [31]庚申，分荊、益州五郡置三巴校尉。

translations.literal: [31] On gengshen, from five commanderies of Jing and Yi provinces the Commandant of Sanba was established.
translations.idiomatic: [31] On the gengshen day the Commandant of Sanba was established from five commanderies of Jing and Yi provinces.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月乙亥，初制間二年一祭南郊，間一年一祭明堂。

translations.literal: Sixth year, spring, first month, yihai day, regulations were first established for offering at the Southern Altar every two years and at the Bright Hall every other year.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, on the yihai day in the first month of spring, regulations were first established for offering at the Southern Altar every two years and at the Bright Hall every other year.

sentences.zh: 二月壬寅，司徒建安王休仁為太尉，領司徒。

translations.literal: Second month, renyin day, Chancellor Prince Xiuren of Jian'an was made Grand Marshal and retained the Chancellorship.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the renyin day Chancellor Prince Xiuren of Jian'an was appointed Grand Marshal and retained the Chancellorship.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，皇太子納妃。

translations.literal: On guichou, the Crown Prince took a consort.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day the Crown Prince took a consort.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On jiayin, a great amnesty was granted throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day a great amnesty was granted throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 巧注從軍，不在赦例。

translations.literal: Those who falsified records to join the army were excluded from the amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: Those who falsified records to join the army were excluded from the amnesty.

sentences.zh: 班賜各有差。

translations.literal: Distinctions in gifts were granted according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: Gifts were distributed according to rank.

sentences.zh: 三月乙亥，中護軍劉襲卒。

translations.literal: Third month, yihai day, General Who Protects the Army Liu Xi died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the yihai day General Who Protects the Army Liu Xi died.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以太子詹事張永為護軍將軍。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent Zhang Yong was made General Who Protects the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent Zhang Yong was appointed General Who Protects the Army.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸亥，立第六皇子燮為晉熙王。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, guihai day, the sixth imperial son Xie was established as Prince of Jinxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the guihai day the sixth imperial son Xie was enfeoffed as Prince of Jinxi.

sentences.zh: 五月丁丑，以前軍將軍陳胤宗為徐州刺史。

translations.literal: Fifth month, dingchou day, former General of the Vanguard Chen Yinzong was made Inspector of Xu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the dingchou day former General of the Vanguard Chen Yinzong was appointed Inspector of Xu.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以冠軍將軍吐谷渾拾虔為平西將軍。

translations.literal: On dinghai, General Who Conquers Shiqian of Tuyuhun was made General Who Levels the West.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day General Who Conquers Shiqian of Tuyuhun was appointed General Who Levels the West.

sentences.zh: 戊子，奉朝請孔玉為寧州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Court-Attendant Kong Yu was made Inspector of Ning.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day Court-Attendant Kong Yu was appointed Inspector of Ning.

sentences.zh: 六月己亥，以第五皇子智井繼東平沖王休倩。

translations.literal: Sixth month, jihai day, the fifth imperial son Zhijing succeeded Prince Chong of Dongping, Xiujian.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the jihai day the fifth imperial son Zhijing succeeded Prince Chong of Dongping, Xiujian.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以侍中劉韞為撫軍將軍、雍州刺史，前將軍、郢州刺史沈攸之進號鎮軍將軍，揚州刺史桂陽王休範為征南大將軍、江州刺史。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Attendant-in-Ordinary Liu Yun was made General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Yong; former General of the Vanguard and Inspector of Ying Shen Youzhi was promoted to General Who Garrisons the Army; Inspector of Yang Prince Xiufan of Guiyang was made Grand General Who Conquers the South and Inspector of Jiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day Attendant-in-Ordinary Liu Yun was appointed General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Yong; former General of the Vanguard and Inspector of Ying Shen Youzhi was promoted to General Who Garrisons the Army; Inspector of Yang Prince Xiufan of Guiyang was appointed Grand General Who Conquers the South and Inspector of Jiang.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以鎮南將軍、江州刺史王景文為尚書左僕射、揚州刺史，尚書僕射袁粲為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On guimao, General Who Garrisons the South and Inspector of Jiang Wang Jingwen was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Inspector of Yang; Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Yuan Can was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day General Who Garrisons the South and Inspector of Jiang Wang Jingwen was appointed Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Inspector of Yang, and Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Yuan Can was appointed Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 己未，改臨賀郡為臨慶郡，追改東平王休倩為臨慶沖王。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Linhe commandery was renamed Linqing commandery, and Prince Xiujian of Dongping was posthumously renamed Prince Chong of Linqing.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day Linhe commandery was renamed Linqing commandery, and Prince Xiujian of Dongping was posthumously renamed Prince Chong of Linqing.

sentences.zh: 七月丙戌，第五皇子智井薨。

translations.literal: Seventh month, bingxu day, the fifth imperial son Zhijing died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on the bingxu day the fifth imperial son Zhijing died.

sentences.zh: 九月乙丑，中領軍劉勔加平北將軍。

translations.literal: Ninth month, yichou day, Central Army Commander Liu Mian was additionally made General Who Levels the North.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the yichou day Central Army Commander Liu Mian was additionally appointed General Who Levels the North.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，立總明觀，徵學士以充之。

translations.literal: On wuyin, the Zongming Observatory was established and scholars were summoned to fill it.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day the Zongming Observatory was established and scholars were summoned to fill it.

sentences.zh: 置東觀祭酒。

translations.literal: The Libationer of the Eastern Pavilion was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Libationer of the Eastern Pavilion was established.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以第八皇子智渙繼臨慶沖王休倩。

translations.literal: On guiwei, the eighth imperial son Zhihuan succeeded Prince Chong of Linqing, Xiujian.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day the eighth imperial son Zhihuan succeeded Prince Chong of Linqing, Xiujian.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛卯，立第九皇子贊為武陵王。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, xinmao day, the ninth imperial son Zan was established as Prince of Wuling.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the xinmao day the ninth imperial son Zan was enfeoffed as Prince of Wuling.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以前右軍馬詵為北雍州刺史。

translations.literal: On yisi, former General of the Right Ma Shen was made Inspector of Northern Yong.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day former General of the Right Ma Shen was appointed Inspector of Northern Yong.

sentences.zh: 己酉，車駕幸東堂聽訟。

translations.literal: On jiyou, the imperial carriage visited the Eastern Hall to hear lawsuits.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day the emperor visited the Eastern Hall to hear lawsuits.

sentences.zh: 十一月己巳，高麗國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, jisi day, Goguryeo sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the jisi day Goguryeo sent envoys presenting tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸巳，以邊難未息，制父母陷異域，悉使婚宦。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, guisi day, because border troubles had not ceased, it was decreed that those whose parents were captive in foreign lands might marry and take office freely.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the guisi day, because border troubles had not ceased, it was decreed that those whose parents were held captive in foreign lands might marry and take office freely.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以始興郡為宋安郡。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Shixing commandery was renamed Song'an commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day Shixing commandery was renamed Song'an commandery.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，護軍將軍張永遷職。

translations.literal: On bingchen, General Who Protects the Army Zhang Yong was transferred from his post.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day General Who Protects the Army Zhang Yong was transferred from his post.

sentences.zh: 三月辛酉，索虜遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: Third month, xinyou day, the Northern Wei sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the xinyou day Northern Wei envoys presented tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，芮芮國遣使奉獻。

translations.literal: On renxu, Rouran sent envoys presenting tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day Rouran sent envoys presenting tribute.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛丑，減天下死罪一等，凡敕繫悉遣之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, xinchou day, capital crimes throughout the realm were reduced by one degree, and all held by imperial order were released.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the xinchou day capital crimes throughout the realm were reduced by one degree, and all held by imperial order were released.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，於南兗州置新平郡。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Xinping commandery was established within Southern Yan province.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day Xinping commandery was established within Southern Yan province.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，金紫光祿大夫張永領護軍。

translations.literal: On guichou, Grand Master with the Golden Token and Purple Tippet Zhang Yong additionally supervised the Protecting Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day Grand Master with the Golden Token and Purple Tippet Zhang Yong additionally supervised the Protecting Army.

sentences.zh: 五月戊午，司徒建安王休仁有罪，自殺。

translations.literal: Fifth month, wuwu day, Chancellor Prince Xiuren of Jian'an, found guilty of a crime, killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the wuwu day Chancellor Prince Xiuren of Jian'an, found guilty of a crime, killed himself.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以寧朔長史孫超之為廣州刺史，尚書左僕射、揚州刺史王景文以刺史領中書監。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Chief Clerk of the General Who Tranquilizes the North Sun Chaozhi was made Inspector of Guang; Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Inspector of Yang Wang Jingwen held the Directorship of the Central Secretariat concurrently with his inspector's post.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day Chief Clerk of the General Who Tranquilizes the North Sun Chaozhi was appointed Inspector of Guang, and Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Inspector of Yang Wang Jingwen held the Directorship of the Central Secretariat concurrently with his inspector's post.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以尚書右僕射袁粲為尚書令，新除吏部尚書褚淵為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Yuan Can was made Director of the Masters of Writing; newly appointed Minister of Personnel Chu Yuan was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Yuan Can was appointed Director of the Masters of Writing, and newly appointed Minister of Personnel Chu Yuan was appointed Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: [32]辛未，監吳郡王僧虔行湘州刺史。

translations.literal: [32] On xinwei, Supervisor Wang Sengqian of Wu commandery acted as Inspector of Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: [32] On the xinwei day Supervisor Wang Sengqian of Wu commandery acted as Inspector of Xiang.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，追免晉平王休祐為庶人。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Prince Xiuyou of Jinping was posthumously stripped and degraded to commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day Prince Xiuyou of Jinping was posthumously stripped and degraded to commoner status.

sentences.zh: 六月丁酉，以征南大將軍、江州刺史桂陽王休範為驃騎大將軍、南徐州刺史，征北大將軍巴陵王休若為車騎大將軍、江州刺史。

translations.literal: Sixth month, dingyou day, Grand General Who Conquers the South and Inspector of Jiang Prince Xiufan of Guiyang was made Grand General of Agile Cavalry and Inspector of Southern Xu; Grand General Who Conquers the North Prince Xiuruo of Baling was made General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Jiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the dingyou day Grand General Who Conquers the South and Inspector of Jiang Prince Xiufan of Guiyang was appointed Grand General of Agile Cavalry and Inspector of Southern Xu, and Grand General Who Conquers the North Prince Xiuruo of Baling was appointed General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Jiang.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，芮芮國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Rouran sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day Rouran sent envoys presenting tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁巳，罷散騎奏舉郎。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, dingsi day, the Attendant Cavalry Memorial-Presenting Gentlemen were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the dingsi day the Attendant Cavalry Memorial-Presenting Gentlemen were abolished.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，新除車騎大將軍、江州刺史巴陵王休若薨，桂陽王休範以新除驃騎大將軍，還為江州。

translations.literal: On yichou, newly appointed General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Jiang Prince Xiuruo of Baling died; Prince Xiufan of Guiyang, having been newly appointed Grand General of Agile Cavalry, returned to hold Jiang province.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day newly appointed General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Jiang Prince Xiuruo of Baling died; Prince Xiufan of Guiyang, having been newly appointed Grand General of Agile Cavalry, returned to hold Jiang province.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以第三皇子準為撫軍將軍。

translations.literal: On gengwu, the third imperial son Zhun was made General Who Pacifies the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day the third imperial son Zhun was appointed General Who Pacifies the Army.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以太子詹事劉秉為南徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent Liu Bing was made Inspector of Southern Xu.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent Liu Bing was appointed Inspector of Southern Xu.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以寧朔將軍沈懷明為南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuyin, General Who Tranquilizes the North Shen Huaiming was made Inspector of Southern Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day General Who Tranquilizes the North Shen Huaiming was appointed Inspector of Southern Yan.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，於冀州置西海郡。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Xihai commandery was established within Ji province.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day Xihai commandery was established within Ji province.

sentences.zh: 八月戊子，第八皇子躋繼江夏文獻王義恭。

translations.literal: Eighth month, wuzi day, the eighth imperial son Ji succeeded Literary Prince Yigong of Jiangxia.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the wuzi day the eighth imperial son Ji succeeded Literary Prince Yigong of Jiangxia.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以疾愈大赦天下。

translations.literal: On gengyin, because the emperor's illness had improved, a great amnesty was granted throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, because the emperor's illness had improved, a great amnesty was granted throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 冀州刺史劉崇智加青州刺史。

translations.literal: Inspector of Ji Liu Chongzhi was additionally made Inspector of Qing.
translations.idiomatic: Inspector of Ji Liu Chongzhi was additionally appointed Inspector of Qing.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，立第三皇子準為安成王。

translations.literal: On wuxu, the third imperial son Zhun was established as Prince of Ancheng.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day the third imperial son Zhun was enfeoffed as Prince of Ancheng.

sentences.zh: 九月辛未，以越騎校尉周寧民為徐州刺史。

translations.literal: Ninth month, xinwei day, Commandant of Elite Cavalry Zhou Ningmin was made Inspector of Xu.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the xinwei day Commandant of Elite Cavalry Zhou Ningmin was appointed Inspector of Xu.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月戊午，[33]百濟國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month, wuwu day, [33] Baekje sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on the wuwu day, [33] Baekje sent envoys presenting tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁酉，分豫州、南兗州立南豫州，以歷陽太守王玄載為南豫州刺史。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, dingyou day, Southern Yu province was established by dividing Yu and Southern Yan provinces; Administrator of Liyang Wang Xuanzai was made Inspector of Southern Yu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the dingyou day Southern Yu province was established by dividing Yu and Southern Yan provinces, and Administrator of Liyang Wang Xuanzai was appointed Inspector of Southern Yu.

sentences.zh: 泰豫元年春正月甲寅朔，上有疾不朝會。

translations.literal: First year of Taiyu, spring, first month, on the jiayin day at new moon, the emperor was ill and did not hold court.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Taiyu, on the jiayin day at new moon in the first month of spring, the emperor was ill and did not hold court.

sentences.zh: 以疾患未痊，故改元。

translations.literal: Because his illness had not yet healed, the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: Because his illness had not yet healed, the era name was changed.

sentences.zh: 賜孤老貧疾粟帛各有差。

translations.literal: Grain and silk were granted to orphans, the aged, the poor, and the sick, each according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: Grain and silk were granted to orphans, the aged, the poor, and the sick, each according to rank.

sentences.zh: 戊午，皇太子會萬國於東宮，并受貢計。

translations.literal: On wuwu, the Crown Prince received the tribute-accounting assembly of the realm at the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day the Crown Prince received the tribute-accounting assembly of the realm at the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 二月辛丑，以給事黃門侍郎王瞻為司州刺史。

translations.literal: Second month, xinchou day, Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate Wang Zhan was made Inspector of Si.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the xinchou day Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate Wang Zhan was appointed Inspector of Si.

sentences.zh: 三月癸丑朔，林邑國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: Third month, on the guichou day at new moon, Lin Yi sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the guichou day at new moon, Lin Yi sent envoys presenting tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 己未，中書監、揚州刺史王景文卒。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Director of the Central Secretariat and Inspector of Yang Wang Jingwen died.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day Director of the Central Secretariat and Inspector of Yang Wang Jingwen died.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛卯，以撫軍司馬蔡那為益州刺史。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, xinmao day, Major of the General Who Pacifies the Army Cai Na was made Inspector of Yi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the xinmao day Major of the General Who Pacifies the Army Cai Na was appointed Inspector of Yi.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以右衞將軍張興世為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: On guisi, General of the Right Guard Zhang Xingshi was made Inspector of Yong.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day General of the Right Guard Zhang Xingshi was appointed Inspector of Yong.

sentences.zh: [34]己亥，上大漸。

translations.literal: [34] On jihai, the emperor's illness grew critical.
translations.idiomatic: [34] On the jihai day the emperor's illness grew critical.

sentences.zh: 驃騎大將軍、江州刺史桂陽王休範進位司空，尚書右僕射褚淵為護軍將軍，中領軍劉勔加尚書右僕射，鎮東將軍蔡興宗為征西將軍、開府儀同三司、荊州刺史，鎮軍將軍、郢州刺史沈攸之進號安西將軍。

translations.literal: Grand General of Agile Cavalry and Inspector of Jiang Prince Xiufan of Guiyang was promoted to Minister of Works; Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Chu Yuan was made General Who Protects the Army; Central Army Commander Liu Mian was additionally made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; General Who Garrisons the East Cai Xingzong was made General Who Conquers the West with Grandee protocol equal to Three Divisions and Inspector of Jing; General Who Garrisons the Army and Inspector of Ying Shen Youzhi was promoted to General Who Pacifies the West.
translations.idiomatic: Grand General of Agile Cavalry and Inspector of Jiang Prince Xiufan of Guiyang was promoted to Minister of Works; Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Chu Yuan was appointed General Who Protects the Army; Central Army Commander Liu Mian was additionally appointed Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; General Who Garrisons the East Cai Xingzong was appointed General Who Conquers the West with Grandee protocol equal to Three Divisions and Inspector of Jing; General Who Garrisons the Army and Inspector of Ying Shen Youzhi was promoted to General Who Pacifies the West.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「朕自臨御億兆，仍屬戎寇，雖每存弘化，而惠弗覃遠，軍國凋弊，刑訟未息。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Since I came to rule the myriad masses, we have still been afflicted by warfare; though I have ever sought broad transformation, grace has not reached afar, the army and state are depleted, and litigation has not ceased.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "Since I came to rule the myriad masses, we have still been afflicted by warfare; though I have ever sought broad transformation, grace has not reached afar, the army and state are depleted, and litigation has not ceased.

sentences.zh: 今大漸維危，載深矜歎。

translations.literal: Now as my illness grows critical, I am filled with profound pity and sighing.
translations.idiomatic: Now as my illness grows critical, I am filled with profound pity and sighing.

sentences.zh: 可緩徭優調，去繁就約。

translations.literal: Corvée should be eased and levies lightened; the complex should be shed for the simple.
translations.idiomatic: Corvée should be eased and levies lightened; the complex should be shed for the simple.

sentences.zh: 因改之宜，詳有簡衷。

translations.literal: According to what reform requires, let there be careful selection of essentials.
translations.idiomatic: According to what reform requires, let there be careful selection of essentials.

sentences.zh: 務以愛民為先，以宣朕遺意。

translations.literal: Let loving the people come first, to proclaim my final intent.
translations.idiomatic: Let loving the people come first, to proclaim my final intent.

sentences.zh: 」袁粲、褚淵、劉勔、蔡興宗、沈攸之同被顧命。

translations.literal: " Yuan Can, Chu Yuan, Liu Mian, Cai Xingzong, and Shen Youzhi were all entrusted with the emperor's final charge.
translations.idiomatic: " Yuan Can, Chu Yuan, Liu Mian, Cai Xingzong, and Shen Youzhi were all entrusted with the emperor's final charge.

sentences.zh: 是日，上崩于景福殿，時年三十四。

translations.literal: That same day, the emperor died at the Jingfu Hall; he was thirty-four.
translations.idiomatic: That same day the emperor died at the Jingfu Hall, aged thirty-four.

sentences.zh: 五月戊寅，葬臨沂縣莫府山高寧陵。

translations.literal: Fifth month, wuyin day, he was buried at the Gaoning tomb on Mount Mofu in Linyi county.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the wuyin day, he was buried at the Gaoning tomb on Mount Mofu in Linyi county.

sentences.zh: 帝少而和令，風姿端雅。

translations.literal: The emperor from youth was gentle and agreeable, with a dignified and refined bearing.
translations.idiomatic: From youth the emperor was gentle and agreeable, with a dignified and refined bearing.

sentences.zh: 早失所生，養於太后宮內。

translations.literal: He lost his birth mother early and was raised within the empress dowager's palace.
translations.idiomatic: He lost his birth mother early and was raised in the empress dowager's palace.

sentences.zh: 大明世，諸弟多被猜忌，唯上見親，常侍路太后醫藥。

translations.literal: In the Daming era his younger brothers were mostly subject to suspicion, but the emperor alone was treated with affection and often attended Empress Dowager Lu in administering medicine.
translations.idiomatic: During the Daming era his younger brothers were mostly subject to suspicion, but he alone was treated with affection and often attended Empress Dowager Lu in administering medicine.

sentences.zh: 好讀書，愛文義，在藩時，撰江左以來文章志，又續衞瓘所注論語二卷，行於世。

translations.literal: He loved reading and valued literary meaning; while in his princely fief he compiled a record of writings since the Eastern Jin, and also continued the two fascicles of Wei Juan's commentary on the Analects, which circulated in the world.
translations.idiomatic: He loved reading and valued literary meaning; while in his princely fief he compiled a record of writings since the Eastern Jin and continued the two fascicles of Wei Juan's Analects commentary, both of which circulated widely.

sentences.zh: 及即大位，四方反叛，以寬仁待物，諸軍帥有父兄子弟同逆者，並授以禁兵，委任不易，故眾為之用，莫不盡力。

translations.literal: When he ascended the throne, rebellions broke out on all sides; treating men with leniency and benevolence, he entrusted palace-guard troops even to commanders whose fathers, brothers, or sons had joined the rebellion, and did not change these appointments—therefore the masses served him and all exerted themselves to the utmost.
translations.idiomatic: When he ascended the throne rebellions broke out on all sides; treating men with leniency and benevolence, he entrusted palace-guard troops even to commanders whose fathers, brothers, or sons had joined the rebellion and did not change these appointments—so the armies served him willingly and all exerted themselves to the utmost.

sentences.zh: 平定天下，逆黨多被全，其有才能者，並見授用，有如舊臣。

translations.literal: When the realm was pacified, many rebels were spared; those with ability were all appointed to office, as if they were old ministers.
translations.idiomatic: When the realm was pacified many rebels were spared; those with ability were appointed to office as if they were old ministers.

sentences.zh: 才學之士，多蒙引進，參侍文籍，應對左右。

translations.literal: Men of talent and learning were often brought forward, attending on literary records and answering at the emperor's side.
translations.idiomatic: Men of talent and learning were often brought forward to attend on literary records and answer at the emperor's side.

sentences.zh: 於華林園含芳堂講周易，[35]常自臨聽。

translations.literal: In the Hanfang Hall of the Hualin Garden he lectured on the Book of Changes, [35] and the emperor often attended in person to listen.
translations.idiomatic: In the Hanfang Hall of the Hualin Garden he lectured on the Book of Changes, [35] and the emperor often attended in person to listen.

sentences.zh: 末年好鬼神，多忌諱，言語文書，有禍敗凶喪及疑似之言應回避者，數百千品，有犯必加罪戮。

translations.literal: In his later years he favored spirits and ghosts and was much given to taboos; in speech and documents, words of disaster, defeat, mourning, and death, and all suspicious expressions to be avoided, numbered in the hundreds and thousands, and any violation was punished by execution.
translations.idiomatic: In his later years he favored spirits and ghosts and was much given to taboos; speech and documents contained hundreds and thousands of words of disaster, defeat, mourning, and death and other expressions to be avoided, and any violation was punished by execution.

sentences.zh: 改「騧」為馬邊瓜，[36]亦以「騧」字似「禍」字故也。

translations.literal: He changed 「騧」 to 「horse beside melon」, [36] because the character 「騧」 resembles the character for 「calamity」.
translations.idiomatic: He changed the character for a piebald horse to 「horse beside melon」, [36] because that character resembles the one for 「calamity」.

sentences.zh: 以南苑借張永，云「且給三百年，期訖更啟」。

translations.literal: He lent the Southern Park to Zhang Yong, saying, 「It is lent for three hundred years; when the term ends, report again.」
translations.idiomatic: He lent the Southern Park to Zhang Yong, saying, 「It is lent for three hundred years; when the term ends, report again.」

sentences.zh: 其事類皆如此。

translations.literal: Matters of this kind were all like this.
translations.idiomatic: Matters of this kind were all like this.

sentences.zh: 宣陽門，民間謂之白門，上以白門之名不祥，甚諱之。

translations.literal: The Xuanyang Gate was popularly called the White Gate; because the name White Gate was inauspicious, the emperor greatly tabooed it.
translations.idiomatic: The Xuanyang Gate was popularly called the White Gate; because the name was inauspicious, the emperor greatly tabooed it.

sentences.zh: 尚書右丞江謐嘗誤犯，上變色曰：「白汝家門！

translations.literal: Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Jiang Mi once accidentally violated the taboo; the emperor changed color and said, 「White upon your family gate!
translations.idiomatic: Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Jiang Mi once accidentally violated the taboo; the emperor flushed and said, 「May white misfortune befall your family gate!

sentences.zh: 」謐稽顙謝，久之方釋。

translations.literal: " Jiang Mi prostrated himself in apology, and only after a long while was he released.
translations.idiomatic: " Jiang Mi prostrated himself in apology, and only after a long while was he released.

sentences.zh: 太后停屍漆牀先出東宮，上嘗幸宮，見之怒甚，免中庶子官，職局以之坐者數十人。

translations.literal: When the empress dowager's corpse was first removed from the Eastern Palace on a lacquered couch, the emperor once visited the palace, saw it, and was furious; he dismissed the Palace Aide, and dozens in the office staff were punished for it.
translations.idiomatic: When the empress dowager's corpse was first removed from the Eastern Palace on a lacquered couch, the emperor once visited the palace, saw it, and was furious; he dismissed the Palace Aide, and dozens in the office staff were punished for it.

sentences.zh: [37]內外常慮犯觸，人不自保。

translations.literal: [37] Within and without, people constantly feared giving offense and could not protect themselves.
translations.idiomatic: [37] Within and without, people constantly feared giving offense and could not protect themselves.

sentences.zh: 宮內禁忌尤甚，移牀治壁，必先祭土神，使文士為文詞祝策，如大祭饗。

translations.literal: Taboos within the palace were especially severe; to move a bed or repair a wall, one had first to sacrifice to the earth god, with literary men composing invocations and prayer texts as at a great sacrificial feast.
translations.idiomatic: Taboos within the palace were especially severe; to move a bed or repair a wall one had first to sacrifice to the earth god, with literary men composing invocations and prayer texts as at a great sacrificial feast.

sentences.zh: 泰始、泰豫之際，更忍虐好殺，左右失旨忤意，往往有斮刳斷截者。

translations.literal: In the Taishi and Taiyu years he became still more cruel and fond of killing; attendants who missed his intent and displeased him were often hacked, gouged, or cut apart.
translations.idiomatic: In the Taishi and Taiyu years he became still more cruel and fond of killing; attendants who missed his intent and displeased him were often hacked, gouged, or cut apart.

sentences.zh: 時經略淮、泗，軍旅不息，荒弊積久，府藏空竭。

translations.literal: At that time campaigns were waged along the Huai and Si, armies marched without cease, long neglect had piled up ruin, and the treasury was empty.
translations.idiomatic: At that time campaigns were waged along the Huai and Si, armies marched without cease, long neglect had piled up ruin, and the treasury was empty.

sentences.zh: 內外百官，並日料祿俸；

translations.literal: All officials within and without received only daily rations of salary;
translations.idiomatic: All officials within and without received only daily rations of salary;

sentences.zh: [38]而上奢費過度，務為彫侈。

translations.literal: [38] yet the emperor's extravagance exceeded all bounds, and he pursued carved ornament.
translations.idiomatic: [38] yet the emperor's extravagance exceeded all bounds, and he pursued carved ornament.

sentences.zh: 每所造制，必為正御三十副，御次、副又各三十，須一物輒造九十枚，天下騷然，民不堪命。

translations.literal: For every object he ordered made, there had to be thirty sets for the primary imperial use, and thirty each for secondary imperial and subordinate use as well; a single item required ninety pieces to be made—the realm was in uproar and the people could not bear the burden.
translations.idiomatic: For every object he ordered made, there had to be thirty sets for primary imperial use and thirty each for secondary imperial and subordinate use as well; a single item required ninety pieces—the realm was in uproar and the people could not bear the burden.

sentences.zh: 其餘事迹，列見眾篇。

translations.literal: His remaining deeds are set forth in the various chapters.
translations.idiomatic: His remaining deeds are set forth in the various chapters.

sentences.zh: [39]親近讒慝，剪落皇枝，宋氏之業，自此衰矣。

translations.literal: [39] Through favoring slanderers and villains and cutting down the imperial branches, the house of Song from this point declined.
translations.idiomatic: [39] Through favoring slanderers and villains and cutting down the imperial branches, the house of Song from this point declined.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：聖人立法垂制，所以必稱先王，蓋由遺訓餘風，足以貽之來世也。

translations.literal: The historian says: When sages establish law and transmit institutions, they must invoke the former kings, because the legacy of instruction and surviving custom is enough to bequeath to later generations.
translations.idiomatic: The historian says: When sages establish law and transmit institutions, they must invoke the former kings, because the legacy of instruction and surviving custom is enough to bequeath to later generations.

sentences.zh: 太祖負扆南面，實有君人之懿焉，經國之義雖弘，而隆家之道不足。

translations.literal: Emperor Taizu, bearing the imperial screen and facing south, truly possessed the excellence of a ruler; though his principles of governing the state were broad, his way of elevating the family was insufficient.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Taizu, bearing the imperial screen and facing south, truly possessed the excellence of a ruler; though his principles of governing the state were broad, his way of elevating the family was insufficient.

sentences.zh: 彭城王照不窺古，本無卓爾之資，[40]徒見昆弟之義，未識君臣之禮，冀以此家情，行之國道，主猜而猶犯，恩薄而未悟，致以呵訓之微行，遂成滅親之大禍。

translations.literal: Prince Zhao of Pengcheng did not look to antiquity and by nature lacked outstanding talent, [40] yet seeing only the affection between brothers and not understanding the rites between ruler and minister, he hoped to apply this family sentiment to the way of the state; the ruler was suspicious yet he still transgressed, favor was thin yet he did not awaken—thus from the slight act of a scolding he brought about the great calamity of destroying kin.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Zhao of Pengcheng did not look to antiquity and by nature lacked outstanding talent, [40] yet seeing only the affection between brothers and not understanding the rites between ruler and minister, he hoped to apply this family sentiment to the way of the state; the ruler was suspicious yet he still transgressed, favor was thin yet he did not awaken—thus from the slight act of a scolding he brought about the great calamity of destroying kin.

sentences.zh: 開端樹隙，垂之後人。

translations.literal: He opened the beginning and planted the rift, and bequeathed it to later men.
translations.idiomatic: He opened the beginning and planted the rift, bequeathing it to later men.

sentences.zh: 雖天倫之重，義殊凡戚，而中人以下，情由恩變。

translations.literal: Though the weight of heavenly kinship differs from ordinary affection, for men of middling capacity and below, feeling follows favor and changes.
translations.idiomatic: Though the weight of heavenly kinship differs from ordinary affection, for men of middling capacity and below, feeling follows favor and changes.

sentences.zh: 至於易衣而出，分苦而食，與夫別宮異門，形疎事隔者，宜有降矣。

translations.literal: As for changing clothes to go out, sharing hardship in eating, and on the other hand separate palaces and different gates, form estranged and affairs divided—there ought to be a lowering of degree.
translations.idiomatic: As for changing clothes to go out and sharing hardship in eating, versus separate palaces and different gates with form estranged and affairs divided—there ought to be a lowering of degree.

sentences.zh: 太宗因易隙之情，據已行之典，剪落洪枝，願不待慮。

translations.literal: Emperor Ming, exploiting the sentiment of an easy rift and relying on an established precedent, cut down the great branches without waiting for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ming, exploiting the sentiment of an easy rift and relying on an established precedent, cut down the great branches without waiting for deliberation.

sentences.zh: 既而本根無庇，幼主孤立，神器以勢弱傾移，靈命隨樂推回改。

translations.literal: Thereafter the root had no shelter, the young ruler stood alone, the sacred vessel shifted because power was weak, and the mandate changed with the turning of popular acclaim.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter the root had no shelter, the young ruler stood alone, the sacred vessel shifted because power was weak, and the mandate changed with the turning of popular acclaim.

sentences.zh: 斯蓋履霜有漸，堅冰自至，所從來遠也。

translations.literal: This is like frost forming by degrees and solid ice arriving of itself—the source lies far back.
translations.idiomatic: This is like frost forming by degrees and solid ice arriving of itself—the source lies far back.

sentences.zh: 校勘記

translations.literal: Collation notes
translations.idiomatic: Textual collation notes

sentences.zh: 南徐州刺史永嘉王子仁為中軍將軍 各本並脫「南」字，據永嘉王子仁傳補。

translations.literal: Inspector of Southern Xu Prince Ziren of Yongjia was made General of the Central Army — all editions omit the character 「Southern」, supplied according to the biography of Prince Ziren of Yongjia.
translations.idiomatic: Inspector of Southern Xu Prince Ziren of Yongjia was made General of the Central Army — all editions omit 「Southern」, supplied according to the biography of Prince Ziren of Yongjia.

sentences.zh: 癸酉 各本並作「壬午」，據建康實錄改。

translations.literal: Guiyou — all editions read 「renwu」, corrected according to the Jiankang shilu.
translations.idiomatic: Guiyou — all editions read 「renwu」, corrected according to the Jiankang shilu.

sentences.zh: 按是月庚申朔，十三日壬申，十六日乙亥。

translations.literal: According to this, the first month had gengshen as new moon; the thirteenth day was renshen, the sixteenth day yihai.
translations.idiomatic: According to this, the first month had gengshen as new moon; the thirteenth day was renshen and the sixteenth day yihai.

sentences.zh: 宋書本紀此詔在十三日壬申後，十六日乙亥前，則作壬午誤，作癸酉是。

translations.literal: In the annals of the Song shu this edict falls after the thirteenth day renshen and before the sixteenth day yihai; therefore 「renwu」 is wrong and 「guiyou」 is correct.
translations.idiomatic: In the Song shu annals this edict falls after renshen on the thirteenth and before yihai on the sixteenth; therefore 「renwu」 is wrong and 「guiyou」 is correct.

sentences.zh: 詳悉條奏 「詳」各本並作「許」，據元龜二一三改。

translations.literal: Report in full detail — 「detail」 in all editions reads 「permit」, corrected according to Yuan gui 213.
translations.idiomatic: Report in full detail — 「detail」 in all editions reads 「permit」, corrected according to Yuan gui 213.

sentences.zh: 輔國將軍劉勔前鋒西討 「西討」各本作「南討」，據南史改。

translations.literal: General Who Assists the State Liu Mian as vanguard campaigning west — 「campaigning west」 in all editions reads 「campaigning south」, corrected according to the History of the Southern Dynasties.
translations.idiomatic: General Who Assists the State Liu Mian as vanguard campaigning west — 「campaigning west」 in all editions reads 「campaigning south」, corrected according to the History of the Southern Dynasties.

sentences.zh: 按劉勔時攻壽陽，當云「西討」。

translations.literal: According to this, Liu Mian was then attacking Shouyang; it should read 「campaigning west.」
translations.idiomatic: Liu Mian was then attacking Shouyang; it should read 「campaigning west.」

sentences.zh: 撫軍將軍殷孝祖攻赭圻死之以輔國將軍沈攸之代為南討前鋒 「撫軍」下脫文十三字，據南史補。

translations.literal: General Who Pacifies the Army Yin Xiaozu attacked Zhuyi and died; General Who Assists the State Shen Youzhi replaced him as vanguard of the southern campaign — thirteen characters are missing after 「Pacifies the Army」, supplied according to the History of the Southern Dynasties.
translations.idiomatic: General Who Pacifies the Army Yin Xiaozu attacked Zhuyi and died; General Who Assists the State Shen Youzhi replaced him as vanguard of the southern campaign — thirteen characters are missing after 「Pacifies the Army」, supplied according to the History of the Southern Dynasties.

sentences.zh: 時殷孝祖為撫軍將軍。

translations.literal: At that time Yin Xiaozu was General Who Pacifies the Army.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Yin Xiaozu was General Who Pacifies the Army.

sentences.zh: 史事參沈攸之傳、殷孝祖傳。

translations.literal: The historical events may be compared in the biographies of Shen Youzhi and Yin Xiaozu.
translations.idiomatic: The historical events may be compared in the biographies of Shen Youzhi and Yin Xiaozu.

sentences.zh: 葬崇憲皇太后於修寧陵 「修」各本並譌「攸」，據南史、通鑑改。

translations.literal: Empress Dowager Chongxian was buried at the Xiuning tomb — 「xiu」 in all editions is corrupted as 「you」, corrected according to the History of the Southern Dynasties and Zizhi tongjian.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Dowager Chongxian was buried at the Xiuning tomb — 「xiu」 in all editions is corrupted as 「you」, corrected according to the History of the Southern Dynasties and Zizhi tongjian.

sentences.zh: 通鑑胡三省注曰：「修寧陵，在孝武陵東南。」

translations.literal: Hu Sheng's note in the Zizhi tongjian says: 「The Xiuning tomb lies southeast of the tomb of Emperor Xiaowu.」
translations.idiomatic: Hu Sheng's note in the Zizhi tongjian says: 「The Xiuning tomb lies southeast of the tomb of Emperor Xiaowu.」

sentences.zh: 以建安王休仁世子伯融為豫州刺史 「豫州」建安王休仁傳作「南豫州」。

translations.literal: Heir of Prince Xiuren of Jian'an Bo Rong was made Inspector of Yu — 「Yu」 in the biography of Prince Xiuren of Jian'an reads 「Southern Yu」.
translations.idiomatic: Heir of Prince Xiuren of Jian'an Bo Rong was made Inspector of Yu — the biography of Prince Xiuren of Jian'an reads 「Southern Yu」.

sentences.zh: 以吳郡太守顧覬之為湘州刺史 「覬」各本並作「顗」，據覬之傳改。

translations.literal: Administrator of Wu commandery Gu Guzhi was made Inspector of Xiang — 「Gu」 in all editions reads 「Gu (different character)」, corrected according to the biography of Guzhi.
translations.idiomatic: Administrator of Wu commandery Gu Guzhi was made Inspector of Xiang — 「Gu」 in all editions reads a homophonous graph, corrected according to the biography of Guzhi.

sentences.zh: 曲赦揚南徐二州 各本並脫「南」字，據建康實錄補。

translations.literal: Partial amnesty for Yang and Southern Xu provinces — all editions omit 「Southern」, supplied according to the Jiankang shilu.
translations.idiomatic: Partial amnesty for Yang and Southern Xu provinces — all editions omit 「Southern」, supplied according to the Jiankang shilu.

sentences.zh: 出獻納貢 「出」元龜一九八作「來」。

translations.literal: Presenting tribute and offerings — 「presenting」 in Yuan gui 198 reads 「coming」.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting tribute and offerings — Yuan gui 198 reads 「coming」 for 「presenting」.

sentences.zh: 夫秉機詢政 「秉」各本並作「矢」，據元龜二一二改。

translations.literal: Grasping the moment to inquire into government — 「grasping」 in all editions reads 「arrow」, corrected according to Yuan gui 212.
translations.idiomatic: Grasping the moment to inquire into government — 「grasping」 in all editions reads 「arrow」, corrected according to Yuan gui 212.

sentences.zh: 以輔國將軍劉靈遺為梁南秦二州刺史 「劉靈遺」各本並作「劉靈道」。
