translations.literal: General Who Assists the State Liu Lingyi was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin — 「Liu Lingyi」 in all editions reads 「Liu Lingdao」.
translations.idiomatic: General Who Assists the State Liu Lingyi was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin — 「Liu Lingyi」 in all editions reads 「Liu Lingdao」.

sentences.zh: 張森楷校勘記云：「當作『劉靈遺』，鄧琬傳可證。

translations.literal: Zhang Senkai's collation notes say: 「It should read 「Liu Lingyi」, as the biography of Deng Wan proves.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Senkai notes: 「It should read 「Liu Lingyi」, as the biography of Deng Wan proves.

sentences.zh: 下四年亦作『劉靈遺』。

translations.literal: In the fourth year below it also reads 「Liu Lingyi.」
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year below it also reads 「Liu Lingyi.」

sentences.zh: 」按張說是，今改正。

translations.literal: " According to Zhang, this is correct; it is corrected here.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhang is correct; it is corrected here.

sentences.zh: 以游擊將軍垣閎為益州刺史 「垣閎」各本並作「垣閬」。

translations.literal: Mobile-Warfare General Yuan Hong was made Inspector of Yi — 「Yuan Hong」 in all editions reads 「Yuan Lang」.
translations.idiomatic: Mobile-Warfare General Yuan Hong was made Inspector of Yi — 「Yuan Hong」 in all editions reads 「Yuan Lang」.

sentences.zh: 張森楷校勘記云：「垣閬，大明三年已為竟陵王誕所殺，見垣護之傳。

translations.literal: Zhang Senkai's collation notes say: 「Yuan Lang had already been killed by Prince of Jingling Xian in the third year of Daming, as seen in the biography of Yuan Huzhi.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Senkai notes: 「Yuan Lang had already been killed by Prince of Jingling Xian in the third year of Daming, as seen in the biography of Yuan Huzhi.

sentences.zh: 此為垣閎之誤。

translations.literal: This is an error for Yuan Hong.」
translations.idiomatic: This is an error for Yuan Hong.」

sentences.zh: 」按張說是，今改正。

translations.literal: " According to Zhang, this is correct; it is corrected here.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhang is correct; it is corrected here.

sentences.zh: 以御史中丞羊希為廣州刺史 「羊希」各本並作「羊南」，據羊玄保傳，兄子希時由御史中丞出為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: Censor-in-Chief Yang Xi was made Inspector of Guang — 「Yang Xi」 in all editions reads 「Yang Nan」, according to the biography of Yang Xuanbao, whose nephew Xi was then leaving the post of Censor-in-Chief to become Inspector of Guang.
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-Chief Yang Xi was made Inspector of Guang — 「Yang Xi」 in all editions reads 「Yang Nan」; according to the biography of Yang Xuanbao, whose nephew Xi was then leaving the post of Censor-in-Chief to become Inspector of Guang.

sentences.zh: 「南」字誤，今改正。

translations.literal: The character 「Nan」 is wrong; it is corrected here.
translations.idiomatic: The character 「Nan」 is wrong; it is corrected here.

sentences.zh: 珍奇子超越為北冀州刺史 孫虨宋書考論云：「劉勔傳，超越為北豫州刺史，非北冀州。」

translations.literal: Zhenqi's son Chaoyue was made Inspector of Northern Ji — Sun Biao's study of the Song shu says: 「In the biography of Liu Mian, Chaoyue was Inspector of Northern Yu, not Northern Ji.」
translations.idiomatic: Zhenqi's son Chaoyue was made Inspector of Northern Ji — Sun Biao's study of the Song shu says: 「In the biography of Liu Mian, Chaoyue was Inspector of Northern Yu, not Northern Ji.」

sentences.zh: 右光祿大夫車騎將軍護軍將軍王玄謨薨 三朝本、北監本、毛本、殿本作「右光祿大夫」，局本及王玄謨傳作「左光祿大夫」。

translations.literal: Right Grand Master of the Palace, General of Chariots and Cavalry, and General Who Protects the Army Wang Xuamo died — the Song, Sanchao, Beijian, Mao, and Dian editions read 「Right Grand Master of the Palace」; the Bureau edition and the biography of Wang Xuamo read 「Left Grand Master of the Palace」.
translations.idiomatic: Right Grand Master of the Palace, General of Chariots and Cavalry, and General Who Protects the Army Wang Xuamo died — the Song, Sanchao, Beijian, Mao, and Dian editions read 「Right Grand Master of the Palace」; the Bureau edition and Wang Xuamo's biography read 「Left Grand Master of the Palace」.

sentences.zh: 三月己未 下有戊辰。

translations.literal: Third month, jiwei — below this is wuchen.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jiwei — below this is wuchen.

sentences.zh: 按是月丙子朔，無己未、戊辰。

translations.literal: According to this, the month had bingzi as new moon; there were no jiwei or wuchen days.
translations.idiomatic: That month had bingzi as new moon; there were no jiwei or wuchen days.

sentences.zh: 二十日乙未，二十三日戊戌。

translations.literal: The twentieth day was yimou, the twenty-third day wuxu.
translations.idiomatic: The twentieth day was yimou and the twenty-third day wuxu.

sentences.zh: 己未或乙未之譌，戊辰或戊戌之譌。

translations.literal: 「Jiwei」 may be a corruption of 「yimou」, and 「wuchen」 a corruption of 「wuxu」.
translations.idiomatic: 「Jiwei」 may be a corruption of 「yimou」, and 「wuchen」 a corruption of 「wuxu」.

sentences.zh: 以軍司馬劉靈遺為梁南秦二州刺史 孫虨宋書考論云：「軍上脫一字。」

translations.literal: Army Major Liu Lingyi was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin — Sun Biao's study of the Song shu says: 「One character is missing before 「Army.」」
translations.idiomatic: Army Major Liu Lingyi was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin — Sun Biao's study of the Song shu says: 「One character is missing before 「Army.」」

sentences.zh: 南譙太守孫奉伯為交州刺史 「南譙」各本並作「譙南」，據州郡志訂正。

translations.literal: Administrator of Southern Qiao Sun Fengbo was made Inspector of Jiao — 「Southern Qiao」 in all editions reads 「Qiao South」, corrected according to the Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: Administrator of Southern Qiao Sun Fengbo was made Inspector of Jiao — 「Southern Qiao」 in all editions reads 「Qiao South」, corrected according to the Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies.

sentences.zh: 殺刺史羊希 「羊希」各本並譌「羊南」，據南史、建康實錄、通鑑及本書羊玄保傳兄子希附傳改正。

translations.literal: Inspector Yang Xi was killed — 「Yang Xi」 in all editions is corrupted as 「Yang Nan」, corrected according to the History of the Southern Dynasties, Jiankang shilu, Zizhi tongjian, and the attached biography of Xi, nephew of Yang Xuanbao in this book.
translations.idiomatic: Inspector Yang Xi was killed — 「Yang Xi」 in all editions is corrupted as 「Yang Nan」, corrected according to the History of the Southern Dynasties, Jiankang shilu, Zizhi tongjian, and Xi's attached biography in this book.

sentences.zh: 復減郡縣田祿之半 「田祿」各本及通鑑並作「田租」。

translations.literal: Again reduced commandery and county field stipends by half — 「field stipends」 in all editions and the Zizhi tongjian read 「field rent」.
translations.idiomatic: Again reduced commandery and county field stipends by half — 「field stipends」 in all editions and the Zizhi tongjian read 「field rent」.

sentences.zh: 按普減國內田租之半，決非專制帝王之所肯為，當是減削郡縣官吏田祿之半。

translations.literal: A general halving of field rent throughout the realm is certainly not what an autocratic emperor would undertake; this must be a halving of the field stipends of commandery and county officials.
translations.idiomatic: A general halving of field rent throughout the realm is certainly not what an autocratic emperor would undertake; this must be a halving of the field stipends of commandery and county officials.

sentences.zh: 建康實錄作「田祿」，是。

translations.literal: The Jiankang shilu reads 「field stipends」, which is correct.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiankang shilu reads 「field stipends」, which is correct.

sentences.zh: 今據改。

translations.literal: It is corrected here accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: It is corrected here accordingly.

sentences.zh: 丙申東海王褘改封廬江王 各本並脫去「丙申」二字，據南史、建康實錄補。

translations.literal: On bingchen Prince Hui of Donghai was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Lujiang — all editions omit the two characters 「bingchen」, supplied according to the History of the Southern Dynasties and Jiankang shilu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Prince Hui of Donghai was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Lujiang — all editions omit 「bingchen」, supplied according to the History of the Southern Dynasties and Jiankang shilu.

sentences.zh: 五月乙巳 各本並作「乙未」，按是月乙巳朔，無乙未。

translations.literal: Fifth month, yisi — all editions read 「yimou」; according to this the month had yisi as new moon, so there was no yimou.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, yisi — all editions read 「yimou」; that month had yisi as new moon, so there was no yimou.

sentences.zh: 下有十九日癸亥。

translations.literal: Below this is the nineteenth day, guihai.
translations.idiomatic: Below this is guihai on the nineteenth.

sentences.zh: 此乙未當是乙巳之誤，今改正。

translations.literal: This 「yimou」 must be an error for 「yisi」; it is corrected here.
translations.idiomatic: This 「yimou」 must be an error for 「yisi」; it is corrected here.

sentences.zh: 以南康相劉勃為交州刺史 張森楷校勘記云：「劉勔傳，有弟斅，泰始中，為寧朔將軍、交州刺史，於道遇病卒。

translations.literal: Chancellor of Nankang Liu Bo was made Inspector of Jiao — Zhang Senkai's collation notes say: 「In the biography of Liu Mian there is a younger brother Jiao, who in the Taishi era was General Who Tranquilizes the North and Inspector of Jiao and died of illness on the road.
translations.idiomatic: Chancellor of Nankang Liu Bo was made Inspector of Jiao — Zhang Senkai notes: 「In the biography of Liu Mian there is a younger brother Jiao, who in the Taishi era was General Who Tranquilizes the North and Inspector of Jiao and died of illness on the road.

sentences.zh: 勃、斅形近，當即一人。」

translations.literal: Bo and Jiao are graphically similar; they must be the same person.」
translations.idiomatic: Bo and Jiao are graphically similar; they must be the same person.」

sentences.zh: 以輔國將軍沈文靖為東青州刺史 「沈文靖」沈文秀傳及通鑑作「沈文靜」。

translations.literal: General Who Assists the State Shen Wenjing was made Inspector of Eastern Qing — 「Shen Wenjing」 in the biography of Shen Wenxiu and the Zizhi tongjian reads 「Shen Wenjing (different character)」.
translations.idiomatic: General Who Assists the State Shen Wenjing was made Inspector of Eastern Qing — the biography of Shen Wenxiu and the Zizhi tongjian read a variant graph for 「Wenjing」.

sentences.zh: 尋劫制科罪 「劫」各本並作「剏」。

translations.literal: Soon after, robbery was made a statutory crime — 「robbery」 in all editions reads 「create」.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after, robbery was made a statutory crime — 「robbery」 in all editions reads 「create」.

sentences.zh: 孫虨宋書考論云：「當云劫制，剏字誤。

translations.literal: Sun Biao's study of the Song shu says: 「It should read robbery statute; the character 「create」 is wrong.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Biao's study of the Song shu says: 「It should read robbery statute; the character 「create」 is wrong.

sentences.zh: 」按孫說是，今改正。

translations.literal: " According to Sun, this is correct; it is corrected here.
translations.idiomatic: " Sun is correct; it is corrected here.

sentences.zh: 立晉平王休祐子宣曜為南平王 各本並脫「立」字，據南史、建康實錄補。

translations.literal: Xuanyao, son of Prince Xiuyou of Jinping, was established as Prince of Nanping — all editions omit the character 「establish」, supplied according to the History of the Southern Dynasties and Jiankang shilu.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanyao, son of Prince Xiuyou of Jinping, was established as Prince of Nanping — all editions omit 「establish」, supplied according to the History of the Southern Dynasties and Jiankang shilu.

sentences.zh: 息事衡樊 「息」各本並作「自」，據元龜二一三及六四五改正。

translations.literal: Rest from affairs behind the gate — 「rest」 in all editions reads 「self」, corrected according to Yuan gui 213 and 645.
translations.idiomatic: Rest from affairs behind the gate — 「rest」 in all editions reads 「self」, corrected according to Yuan gui 213 and 645.

sentences.zh: 輔師將軍孟次陽為兗州刺史 各本並脫「次」字，據阮佃夫傳、殷琰傳補。

translations.literal: General Who Assists the Army Meng Ciyang was made Inspector of Yan — all editions omit the character 「Ci」, supplied according to the biographies of Ruan Dianfu and Yin Yan.
translations.idiomatic: General Who Assists the Army Meng Ciyang was made Inspector of Yan — all editions omit 「Ci」, supplied according to the biographies of Ruan Dianfu and Yin Yan.

sentences.zh: 以征北大將軍南徐州刺史桂陽王休範為中書監中軍將軍揚州刺史 「中軍將軍」各本並作「中將軍」，據桂陽王休範傳補。

translations.literal: Grand General Who Conquers the North and Inspector of Southern Xu Prince Xiufan of Guiyang was made Director of the Central Secretariat, General of the Central Army, and Inspector of Yang — 「General of the Central Army」 in all editions reads 「Central General」, supplied according to the biography of Prince Xiufan of Guiyang.
translations.idiomatic: Grand General Who Conquers the North and Inspector of Southern Xu Prince Xiufan of Guiyang was made Director of the Central Secretariat, General of the Central Army, and Inspector of Yang — 「General of the Central Army」 in all editions reads 「Central General」, supplied according to the biography of Prince Xiufan of Guiyang.

sentences.zh: 輔師將軍建安王世子伯融為廣州刺史 各本並脫「伯」字。

translations.literal: Heir of Prince Xiuren of Jian'an and General Who Assists the Army Bo Rong was made Inspector of Guang — all editions omit the character 「Bo」.
translations.idiomatic: Heir of Prince Xiuren of Jian'an and General Who Assists the Army Bo Rong was made Inspector of Guang — all editions omit 「Bo」.

sentences.zh: 據始安王休仁傳補。

translations.literal: Supplied according to the biography of Prince Xiuren of Shi'an.
translations.idiomatic: Supplied according to the biography of Prince Xiuren of Shi'an.

sentences.zh: 新除吏部尚書褚淵為尚書右僕射 「右僕射」各本及通鑑並作「左僕射」。

translations.literal: Newly appointed Minister of Personnel Chu Yuan was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing — 「Right Vice Director」 in all editions and the Zizhi tongjian read 「Left Vice Director」.
translations.idiomatic: Newly appointed Minister of Personnel Chu Yuan was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing — 「Right Vice Director」 in all editions and the Zizhi tongjian read 「Left Vice Director」.

sentences.zh: 今據南齊書褚淵傳、南史、建康實錄改。

translations.literal: It is corrected here according to the biography of Chu Yuan in the Book of Qi of the Southern Qi, the History of the Southern Dynasties, and the Jiankang shilu.
translations.idiomatic: Corrected here according to the biography of Chu Yuan in the Book of Qi of the Southern Qi, the History of the Southern Dynasties, and the Jiankang shilu.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月戊午 「十一月」各本並作「十月」。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month, wuwu — 「eleventh month」 in all editions reads 「tenth month」.
translations.idiomatic: Winter, eleventh month, wuwu — 「eleventh month」 in all editions reads 「tenth month」.

sentences.zh: 據建康實錄改。

translations.literal: Corrected according to the Jiankang shilu.
translations.idiomatic: Corrected according to the Jiankang shilu.

sentences.zh: 按十月丙戌朔，無戊午。

translations.literal: According to this, the tenth month had bingxu as new moon; there was no wuwu.
translations.idiomatic: The tenth month had bingxu as new moon; there was no wuwu.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙卯朔，初四日戊午。

translations.literal: The eleventh month had yimao as new moon; the fourth day was wuwu.
translations.idiomatic: The eleventh month had yimao as new moon; the fourth day was wuwu.

sentences.zh: 以右衞將軍張興世為雍州刺史 各本並脫「世」字。

translations.literal: General of the Right Guard Zhang Xingshi was made Inspector of Yong — all editions omit the character 「Shi」.
translations.idiomatic: General of the Right Guard Zhang Xingshi was made Inspector of Yong — all editions omit 「Shi」.

sentences.zh: 據張興世傳補。

translations.literal: Supplied according to the biography of Zhang Xingshi.
translations.idiomatic: Supplied according to the biography of Zhang Xingshi.

sentences.zh: 於華林園含芳堂講周易 各本並脫「含」字，據元龜一九二補。

translations.literal: In the Hanfang Hall of the Hualin Garden he lectured on the Book of Changes — all editions omit the character 「Han」, supplied according to Yuan gui 192.
translations.idiomatic: In the Hanfang Hall of the Hualin Garden he lectured on the Book of Changes — all editions omit 「Han」, supplied according to Yuan gui 192.

sentences.zh: 改騧為馬邊瓜 三朝本、北監本、毛本、殿本無「馬」字，今據局本及魏書島夷傳、南史補。

translations.literal: Changed 「騧」 to 「horse beside melon」 — the Sanchao, Beijian, Mao, and Dian editions lack the character 「horse」; it is supplied here according to the Bureau edition, the biography of the island barbarians in the Wei shu, and the History of the Southern Dynasties.
translations.idiomatic: Changed the piebald-horse character to 「horse beside melon」 — the Sanchao, Beijian, Mao, and Dian editions lack 「horse」; it is supplied here according to the Bureau edition, the island-barbarians biography in the Wei shu, and the History of the Southern Dynasties.

sentences.zh: 職局以之坐者數十人 魏書島夷傳、南史、建康實錄「坐」下有「死」字。

translations.literal: Dozens in the office staff were punished for it — in the island-barbarians biography of the Wei shu, the History of the Southern Dynasties, and the Jiankang shilu, the character 「death」 follows 「punished」.
translations.idiomatic: Dozens in the office staff were punished for it — in the island-barbarians biography of the Wei shu, the History of the Southern Dynasties, and the Jiankang shilu, 「death」 follows 「punished」.

sentences.zh: 並日料祿俸 各本並同。

translations.literal: All received only daily rations of salary — all editions agree.
translations.idiomatic: All received only daily rations of salary — all editions agree.

sentences.zh: 魏書島夷傳作「普斷祿奉」。

translations.literal: The island-barbarians biography of the Wei shu reads 「salaries universally cut off」.
translations.idiomatic: The island-barbarians biography of the Wei shu reads 「salaries universally cut off」.

sentences.zh: 南史及通鑑作「並斷祿奉」。

translations.literal: The History of the Southern Dynasties and the Zizhi tongjian read 「salaries all cut off」.
translations.idiomatic: The History of the Southern Dynasties and the Zizhi tongjian read 「salaries all cut off」.

sentences.zh: 列見眾篇 三朝本作「列」。

translations.literal: Set forth in the various chapters — the Sanchao edition reads 「set forth」.
translations.idiomatic: Set forth in the various chapters — the Sanchao edition reads 「set forth」.

sentences.zh: 北監本、毛本、殿本、局本作「別」。

translations.literal: The Beijian, Mao, Dian, and Bureau editions read 「separately」.
translations.idiomatic: The Beijian, Mao, Dian, and Bureau editions read 「separately」.

sentences.zh: 張元濟校勘記云：「所見處不止一篇，故云列見眾篇。」

translations.literal: Zhang Yuanji's collation notes say: 「Where seen, it is not limited to one chapter; therefore it says set forth in the various chapters.」
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yuanji notes: 「Where seen, it is not limited to one chapter; therefore it says set forth in the various chapters.」

sentences.zh: 本無卓爾之資 「資」各本作「姿」，據南史改。

translations.literal: By nature lacked outstanding talent — 「talent」 in all editions reads 「bearing」, corrected according to the History of the Southern Dynasties.
translations.idiomatic: By nature lacked outstanding talent — 「talent」 in all editions reads 「bearing」, corrected according to the History of the Southern Dynasties.
